source.text: הִנֵּ֥ה יֽוֹם־בָּ֖א לַֽיהוָ֑ה וְחֻלַּ֥ק שְׁלָלֵ֖ךְ בְּקִרְבֵּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, a day [is] coming for Yahweh, and will be divided your plunder in your midst.

en.L: Look, a day is coming for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when your plunder will be divided in your midst.
en.B: Look, a day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is coming, when the plunder taken from you will be shared out within your walls.
en.R: Listen, Jerusalem! A day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is coming. Your enemies will divide up the things they have taken from you, right inside your city.

es.L: He aquí, un día viene para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando tu botín será repartido en medio de ti.
es.B: Mira, viene un día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, en que el botín que te quitaron será repartido dentro de tus murallas.
es.R: ¡Escucha, Jerusalén! Viene un día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Tus enemigos se repartirán lo que te quitaron, en medio de tu propia ciudad.

fr.L: Voici, un jour vient pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où ton butin sera partagé au milieu de toi.
fr.B: Voici, un jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} vient, où le butin pris chez toi sera partagé dans tes murs.
fr.R: Écoute, Jérusalem ! Un jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} va venir. Tes ennemis se partageront ce qu’ils t’ont pris, au milieu même de ta ville.

sw.L: Tazama, siku inakuja kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nazo nyara zako zitagawanywa katikati yako.
sw.B: Tazama, siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inakuja, wakati nyara zilizochukuliwa kwako zitagawanywa ndani ya kuta zako.
sw.R: Sikiliza, ewe Yerusalemu! Siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inakuja. Adui zako watagawana vitu walivyokunyang'anya, ndani ya mji wako.

vi.L: Kìa, một ngày đang đến thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, khi của cướp từ ngươi sẽ bị chia ra giữa ngươi.
vi.B: Kìa, một ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang đến, khi của cải bị cướp từ ngươi sẽ được chia nhau ngay trong thành ngươi.
vi.R: Hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem, hãy nghe đây! Một ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang đến. Kẻ thù sẽ chia nhau những gì chúng cướp được của ngươi ngay giữa thành ngươi.

ko.L: 보아라, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 속한 날이 온다. 그때에 너에게서 빼앗은 물건이 네 한가운데서 나누어질 것이다.
ko.B: 보아라, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 온다. 그날에 너에게서 빼앗은 물건이 네 성벽 안에서 나누어질 것이다.
ko.R: 예루살렘아, 들어라! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 오고 있다. 원수들이 너에게서 빼앗은 것을 바로 네 성 안에서 나누어 가질 것이다.

decisions.choice: a day is coming for the LORD: the day of the LORD
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "a day is coming that belongs to the LORD", as Isaiah 2:12 says that the LORD of hosts "has a day". It is the day the prophets call "the day of the LORD", when he comes to judge and to rescue (Joel 1:15, where the main note is; Amos 5:18-20). In this chapter it begins as a day of disaster for Jerusalem (verses 1-2) and becomes the day when the LORD fights for the city and is king over all the earth (verses 3-9).

decisions.choice: your plunder will be divided in your midst: Jerusalem's enemies share out her goods inside the city
decisions.reason: "Your" is feminine singular: the city of Jerusalem is spoken to as a woman, as often in the prophets. Victors divided the plunder after a battle (Judges 5:30; Isaiah 9:2). That they do it "in your midst" means that the city has fallen and the enemy is at ease inside it (verse 2). Verse 14 turns the picture round: the wealth of the nations is gathered in.

decisions.choice: a day of the LORD (B, R); within your walls (B); Listen, Jerusalem! ... Your enemies will divide up (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "a day of the LORD", close to the wording set for "the day of the LORD" (Joel 1:15), while keeping the Hebrew "a day" (m1). Balanced says "within your walls" for "in your midst". Readable names Jerusalem, the city spoken to, and the enemies who divide the plunder (m2).

decisions.choice: "tú" for Jerusalem (feminine singular in Hebrew)
decisions.reason: The city is spoken to as a woman (meaning decision m2), which Spanish "tú" carries as the terms note sets for Zion and Jerusalem; Readable names her, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ngươi" for Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The city spoken to in a word of judgment is "ngươi" at every level, as the terms note sets for cities addressed in rebuke.

source.text: וְאָסַפְתִּ֨י אֶת־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֥ם׀אֶֽל־יְרוּשָׁלִַם֮ לַמִּלְחָמָה֒ וְנִלְכְּדָ֣ה הָעִ֗יר וְנָשַׁ֨סּוּ֙ הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים תִּשָּׁכַ֑בְנָה וְיָצָ֞א חֲצִ֤י הָעִיר֙ בַּגּוֹלָ֔ה וְיֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם לֹ֥א יִכָּרֵ֖ת מִן־הָעִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will gather all the nations to Jerusalem for battle, and will be captured the city, and will be plundered the houses, and the women will be lain with; and will go out half of the city into exile, and the rest of the people not will be cut off from the city.

en.L: And I will gather all the nations against Jerusalem for battle; and the city will be captured, and the houses plundered, and the women violated; and half of the city will go out into exile, but the remainder of the people will not be cut off from the city.
en.B: I will gather all the nations to make war on Jerusalem. The city will be taken, its houses looted and its women raped. Half of the city will go off into exile, but those who remain will not be cut off from the city.
en.R: I will bring all the nations together to fight against Jerusalem. They will capture the city, rob the houses and rape the women. Half of the people of the city will be taken away as prisoners. But the others will not be taken from the city.

es.L: Y reuniré a todas las naciones contra Jerusalén para la batalla; y la ciudad será tomada, y las casas saqueadas, y las mujeres deshonradas; y la mitad de la ciudad saldrá al destierro, pero el resto del pueblo no será cortado de la ciudad.
es.B: Reuniré a todas las naciones para hacer la guerra contra Jerusalén. La ciudad será tomada, sus casas saqueadas y sus mujeres violadas. La mitad de la ciudad irá al destierro, pero los que queden no serán cortados de la ciudad.
es.R: Juntaré a todas las naciones para que peleen contra Jerusalén. Tomarán la ciudad, robarán en las casas y violarán a las mujeres. La mitad de la gente de la ciudad será llevada prisionera. Pero los demás no serán sacados de la ciudad.

fr.L: Et je rassemblerai toutes les nations contre Jérusalem pour la bataille ; et la ville sera prise, et les maisons pillées, et les femmes déshonorées ; et la moitié de la ville partira en exil, mais le reste du peuple ne sera pas retranché de la ville.
fr.B: Je rassemblerai toutes les nations pour faire la guerre à Jérusalem. La ville sera prise, ses maisons pillées et ses femmes violées. La moitié de la ville partira en exil, mais ceux qui resteront ne seront pas retranchés de la ville.
fr.R: Je réunirai toutes les nations pour qu’elles combattent contre Jérusalem. Elles prendront la ville, pilleront les maisons et violeront les femmes. La moitié des habitants sera emmenée en captivité. Mais les autres ne seront pas enlevés de la ville.

sw.L: Nami nitayakusanya mataifa yote juu ya Yerusalemu kwa vita; na mji utatwaliwa, na nyumba zitatekwa nyara, na wanawake watanajisiwa; na nusu ya mji itakwenda uhamishoni, lakini mabaki ya watu hawatakatiliwa mbali na mji.
sw.B: Nitayakusanya mataifa yote kupigana vita dhidi ya Yerusalemu. Mji utatekwa, nyumba zake zitaporwa na wanawake wake watabakwa. Nusu ya mji itakwenda uhamishoni, lakini wale watakaobaki hawatakatiliwa mbali na mji.
sw.R: Nitayakusanya mataifa yote yapigane na Yerusalemu. Watauteka mji, watapora nyumba na kuwabaka wanawake. Nusu ya watu wa mji watachukuliwa mateka. Lakini wengine hawataondolewa mjini.

vi.L: Ta sẽ nhóm mọi nước lại nghịch cùng Giê-ru-sa-lem để giao chiến; thành sẽ bị chiếm, nhà cửa bị cướp phá, đàn bà bị làm nhục; một nửa thành sẽ đi lưu đày, nhưng phần dân còn lại sẽ không bị diệt trừ khỏi thành.
vi.B: Ta sẽ nhóm mọi nước lại để giao chiến với Giê-ru-sa-lem. Thành sẽ bị chiếm, nhà cửa bị cướp bóc, phụ nữ bị hãm hiếp. Một nửa thành sẽ bị lưu đày, nhưng những người còn lại sẽ không bị diệt trừ khỏi thành.
vi.R: Ta sẽ tập hợp mọi nước lại để đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem. Chúng sẽ chiếm thành, cướp nhà cửa và hãm hiếp phụ nữ. Một nửa dân thành sẽ bị bắt đi làm tù binh. Nhưng những người khác sẽ không bị đem ra khỏi thành.

ko.L: 내가 모든 민족을 모아 예루살렘을 치게 하겠다. 그 성읍이 함락되고, 집들이 약탈당하고, 여자들이 욕을 당할 것이다. 성읍의 절반은 포로로 끌려가겠지만, 남은 백성은 성읍에서 끊어지지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 모든 민족을 모아 예루살렘과 싸우게 하겠다. 성은 함락되고, 집들은 약탈당하고, 여자들은 겁탈을 당할 것이다. 성의 절반은 포로로 끌려가겠지만, 남은 사람들은 성에서 끊어지지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 모든 민족을 불러 모아 예루살렘을 공격하게 하겠다. 그들이 성을 점령하고, 집들을 털고, 여자들을 겁탈할 것이다. 성 사람들의 절반은 포로로 끌려갈 것이다. 그러나 나머지 사람들은 성에서 쫓겨나지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: I will gather all the nations: the LORD himself brings the attack on Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks. The nations come because he gathers them, as in Joel 4:2 and Zephaniah 3:8, and as 12:2-3 has already said. The disaster of verses 1-2 is under his hand, and he turns it into judgment on the nations he has gathered (verse 3).

decisions.choice: the women will be violated: the written text has a blunter verb, which is read aloud as "be lain with"
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) give a coarse verb for rape, which is written the same way in Deuteronomy 28:30, Isaiah 13:16 and Jeremiah 3:2; in each place the reading tradition (qere) replaces it with "be lain with", a more modest word for the same act. The data gives the reading tradition. Both forms say that the women are raped.

decisions.choice: half the city into exile, the rest not cut off: a remnant stays
decisions.reason: Exile was the usual fate of the people of a captured city, as Jerusalem had known since 587 BC (2 Kings 25:11). Here only half go; the rest stay in the city. The prophets speak again and again of a remnant that comes through judgment (13:8-9; Isaiah 10:20-22).

decisions.choice: violated (L); raped (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what the Hebrew means (m2), as the style guide asks for such passages; Literal keeps a word closer to the restraint of the reading tradition.

decisions.choice: "deshonradas" (L); "violadas" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the restraint of the reading tradition, Balanced and Readable say plainly what it means (meaning decision m2).

decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps a more restrained word, Balanced and Readable say plainly what it means (meaning decision m2).

source.text: וְיָצָ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְנִלְחַ֖ם בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם הָהֵ֑ם כְּי֥וֹם הִֽלָּחֲמ֖ובְּי֥וֹם קְרָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And will go out Yahweh and will fight against those nations, as [the] day of his fighting on a day of battle.

en.L: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will go out and fight against those nations, as when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} fights on a day of battle.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will go out and fight against those nations, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} fights on the day of battle.
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will go out and fight against those nations. He will fight them as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} always fights on the day of battle.

es.L: Entonces saldrá {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y peleará contra aquellas naciones, como cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} pelea en el día de la batalla.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} saldrá y peleará contra esas naciones, como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} pelea en el día de la batalla.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} saldrá a pelear contra esas naciones. Peleará contra ellas como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} siempre pelea en el día de la batalla.

fr.L: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sortira et combattra contre ces nations, comme lorsqu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} combat au jour de la bataille.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sortira et combattra contre ces nations, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} combat au jour de la bataille.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sortira et combattra contre ces nations. Il les combattra comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} combat toujours au jour de la bataille.

sw.L: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatoka na kupigana na mataifa hayo, kama siku apiganapo katika siku ya vita.
sw.B: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatoka na kupigana na mataifa hayo, kama apiganavyo siku ya vita.
sw.R: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatoka kupigana na mataifa hayo. Atapigana nayo kama apiganavyo siku zote siku ya vita.

vi.L: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ ra đi và chiến đấu nghịch cùng các nước ấy, như khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chiến đấu trong ngày giao chiến.
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ ra đi và chiến đấu với các nước ấy, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chiến đấu trong ngày chiến trận.
vi.R: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ ra đi chiến đấu với các nước ấy. Ngài sẽ đánh chúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn luôn chiến đấu trong ngày chiến trận.

ko.L: 그때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나가셔서 그 민족들과 싸우실 것이다. 전쟁의 날에 싸우시던 날과 같을 것이다.
ko.B: 그때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나가셔서, 전쟁의 날에 싸우시듯이 그 민족들과 싸우실 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나가셔서 그 민족들과 싸우실 것이다. 전쟁의 날에 늘 싸우시는 것처럼 그들과 싸우실 것이다.

decisions.choice: the LORD will go out and fight, as on a day of battle: the LORD as a warrior
decisions.reason: "The LORD will fight for you" was Moses' word at the sea (Exodus 14:14), and the song that followed calls the LORD "a warrior" (Exodus 15:3). Isaiah 42:13 says that the LORD "goes out like a warrior". The comparison is with the battles he has fought for his people before; the verse does not say which.

decisions.choice: those nations: the nations he gathered in verse 2
decisions.reason: The nations the LORD gathered against Jerusalem are the ones he now fights. He brought them to the city to judge them there, as Joel 4:2 and 4:12 say.

decisions.choice: as he always fights on the day of battle (R)
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain that the comparison is with the LORD's way in battle, without naming a particular battle (m1). "He" and "his" for the LORD take the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: "주께서 나가셔서 ... 싸우실 것이다", with -시-, from verse 3 on
decisions.reason: Verse 2 is the LORD's own word; from verse 3 the prophet speaks about the LORD (verse 5 "the LORD my God", meaning decision m4 there), so the LORD takes the honorific.

source.text: וְעָמְד֣וּ רַגְלָ֣יו בַּיּוֹם־הַ֠הוּא עַל־הַ֨ר הַזֵּתִ֜יםאֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַם֮ מִקֶּדֶם֒ וְנִבְקַע֩ הַ֨ר הַזֵּיתִ֤ים מֵֽחֶצְיוֹ֙ מִזְרָ֣חָה וָיָ֔מָּה גֵּ֖יא גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וּמָ֨שׁ חֲצִ֥י הָהָ֛ר צָפ֖וֹנָה וְחֶצְיוֹ־נֶֽגְבָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will stand his feet on that day on [the] Mount of the Olives, which [is] before [the] face of Jerusalem from [the] east; and will be split [the] Mount of the Olives from its middle eastward and westward, a valley great very; and will move half of the mountain northward and half of it southward.

en.L: And in that day {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, which [is] facing Jerusalem to the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split from its middle, eastward and westward, [into] a very great valley; and half of the mountain will move northward, and half of it southward.
en.B: On that day {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet will stand upon the Mount of Olives, which faces Jerusalem on the east. The Mount of Olives will split in two from east to west, opening a very wide valley, as half of the mountain moves north and the other half south.
en.R: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem. The mountain will split in half from east to west, and a huge valley will open up. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and half toward the south.

es.L: Y en aquel día se posarán {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies sobre el monte de los Olivos, que [está] frente a Jerusalén al oriente; y el monte de los Olivos se partirá por su mitad, hacia el oriente y hacia el occidente, [formando] un valle muy grande; y la mitad del monte se moverá hacia el norte, y la otra mitad hacia el sur.
es.B: Aquel día {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies se posarán sobre el monte de los Olivos, que está frente a Jerusalén, al oriente. El monte de los Olivos se partirá en dos de oriente a occidente, y se abrirá un valle muy ancho, pues la mitad del monte se moverá hacia el norte y la otra mitad hacia el sur.
es.R: En ese tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se pondrá de pie sobre el monte de los Olivos, al este de Jerusalén. El monte se partirá por la mitad de este a oeste, y se abrirá un valle enorme. La mitad del monte se moverá hacia el norte, y la otra mitad hacia el sur.

fr.L: Et en ce jour-là, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds se poseront sur le mont des Oliviers, qui [est] en face de Jérusalem, à l’orient ; et le mont des Oliviers se fendra par son milieu, vers l’orient et vers l’occident, [en] une très grande vallée ; et une moitié de la montagne s’écartera vers le nord, et l’autre moitié vers le sud.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds se poseront sur le mont des Oliviers, qui fait face à Jérusalem du côté de l’orient. Le mont des Oliviers se fendra en deux d’est en ouest, ouvrant une très large vallée, tandis qu’une moitié de la montagne s’écartera vers le nord et l’autre vers le sud.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se tiendra debout sur le mont des Oliviers, à l’est de Jérusalem. La montagne se fendra en deux d’est en ouest, et une immense vallée s’ouvrira. Une moitié de la montagne se déplacera vers le nord, et l’autre moitié vers le sud.

sw.L: Na katika siku ile miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} itasimama juu ya Mlima wa Mizeituni, ulio mbele ya Yerusalemu upande wa mashariki; na Mlima wa Mizeituni utapasuka katikati yake, kuelekea mashariki na kuelekea magharibi, [kuwa] bonde kubwa sana; na nusu ya mlima itasogea kuelekea kaskazini, na nusu yake kuelekea kusini.
sw.B: Siku hiyo miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} itasimama juu ya Mlima wa Mizeituni, unaoelekeana na Yerusalemu upande wa mashariki. Mlima wa Mizeituni utapasuka vipande viwili kutoka mashariki hadi magharibi, na bonde pana sana litafunguka, nusu ya mlima ikisogea kaskazini na nusu nyingine kusini.
sw.R: Wakati huo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atasimama juu ya Mlima wa Mizeituni, upande wa mashariki wa Yerusalemu. Mlima utapasuka katikati kutoka mashariki hadi magharibi, na bonde kubwa sana litatokea. Nusu ya mlima itasogea upande wa kaskazini, na nusu nyingine upande wa kusini.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đứng trên núi Ô-li-ve, [là núi] đối diện Giê-ru-sa-lem về phía đông; và núi Ô-li-ve sẽ bị chẻ đôi từ giữa, về phía đông và phía tây, [thành] một thung lũng rất lớn; một nửa núi sẽ dời về phía bắc, và một nửa về phía nam.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đứng trên núi Ô-li-ve, đối diện Giê-ru-sa-lem về phía đông. Núi Ô-li-ve sẽ bị chẻ làm đôi từ đông sang tây, mở ra một thung lũng rất rộng, khi một nửa núi dời về phía bắc và nửa kia về phía nam.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đứng trên núi Ô-li-ve, ở phía đông Giê-ru-sa-lem. Núi sẽ nứt làm đôi từ đông sang tây, và một thung lũng rất lớn sẽ mở ra. Một nửa núi sẽ dời về phía bắc, và nửa kia về phía nam.

ko.L: 그날에 그분의 발이 예루살렘 앞 동쪽에 있는 올리브 산 위에 설 것이다. 올리브 산은 그 한가운데가 동쪽에서 서쪽으로 갈라져 매우 큰 골짜기가 될 것이며, 산의 절반은 북쪽으로, 절반은 남쪽으로 옮겨질 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 그분의 발이 예루살렘 동쪽 맞은편에 있는 올리브 산 위에 설 것이다. 올리브 산이 동쪽에서 서쪽으로 둘로 갈라져 아주 넓은 골짜기가 생기고, 산의 절반은 북쪽으로, 나머지 절반은 남쪽으로 물러날 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예루살렘 동쪽에 있는 올리브 산 위에 서실 것이다. 그 산이 동쪽에서 서쪽으로 반으로 갈라지고, 아주 큰 골짜기가 생길 것이다. 산의 절반은 북쪽으로, 나머지 절반은 남쪽으로 옮겨 갈 것이다.

decisions.choice: the Mount of Olives: the ridge east of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The ridge rises east of Jerusalem across the Kidron Valley, higher than the city. This is the only place in the Hebrew Bible where it is called "the Mount of Olives"; 2 Samuel 15:30 speaks of "the ascent of the olives", which David climbed weeping as he fled from Absalom. In Ezekiel's vision the glory of the LORD left the city and stood on "the mountain east of the city" (Ezekiel 11:23).

decisions.choice: his feet will stand: the LORD comes in person
decisions.reason: The LORD's feet standing on the mountain is a bold picture of his coming in person to fight for the city. The prophets picture the mountains shaking and splitting when he comes (Micah 1:3-4; Nahum 1:5; Habakkuk 3:6).

decisions.choice: the mountain split, a very great valley: a way of escape
decisions.reason: The split opens a valley through which the people flee (verse 5), as the sea was split for Israel to pass through; Exodus 14:16 and 14:21 use the same verb. In Acts 1:9-12 Jesus is taken up into heaven from the Mount of Olives, and the angels say that he will come back in the same way; many readers connect that promise with this verse.

decisions.choice: his feet will stand (L, B); the LORD will stand (R)
decisions.reason: "His" is the LORD, so it takes the deity_pronoun setting. Readable names the LORD and says that he will stand, since a new scene begins and "his feet" would leave the reader asking whose.

decisions.choice: "el monte de los Olivos"
decisions.reason: The name as published in Acts 1:12 and the Gospels, so the link of meaning decision m3 can be seen.

decisions.choice: "le mont des Oliviers"
decisions.reason: The name as published in Acts 1:12 (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: "Mlima wa Mizeituni"
decisions.reason: The name as published in Acts 1:12 (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: "núi Ô-li-ve"
decisions.reason: The name as published in Acts 1:12 (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: "올리브 산"
decisions.reason: The name as published in Acts 1:12 and the Korean style guide (meaning decision m3).

source.text: וְנַסְתֶּ֣ם גֵּֽיא־הָרַ֗י כִּֽי־יַגִּ֣יעַ גֵּי־הָרִים֮ אֶל־אָצַל֒ וְנַסְתֶּ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר נַסְתֶּם֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָרַ֔עַשׁ בִּימֵ֖י עֻזִּיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבָא֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔י כָּל־קְדֹשִׁ֖ים עִמָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will flee [by the] valley of my mountains, for will reach [the] valley of [the] mountains to Azal; and you will flee as you fled from before the earthquake in [the] days of Uzziah king of Judah; and will come Yahweh my God, all [the] holy ones with you.

en.L: And you will flee [through] the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains will reach to Azal; and you will flee just as you fled from the face of the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah; and then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God will come, all the holy ones with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: You will flee through the valley of my mountains, for the valley between the mountains will reach as far as Azal. You will run as you ran from the earthquake during the reign of Uzziah king of Judah. And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God will come; all the holy ones will be with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: You will escape through the valley of my mountains, because that valley will reach as far as Azal. You will run away, just as your ancestors ran from the earthquake while Uzziah was king of Judah. After that, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God will come, and all the holy ones will be with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:huirán|huiréis}} [por] el valle de mis montes, porque el valle de los montes llegará hasta Azal; y {{plural_you:huirán|huiréis}} así como {{plural_you:huyeron|huisteis}} ante el terremoto en los días de Uzías, rey de Judá; y vendrá {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi Dios, todos los santos {{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Huirán|Huiréis}} por el valle de mis montes, porque el valle entre los montes llegará hasta Azal. {{plural_you:Huirán|Huiréis}} como {{plural_you:huyeron|huisteis}} del terremoto durante el reinado de Uzías, rey de Judá. Y vendrá {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi Dios; todos los santos estarán {{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Escaparán|Escaparéis}} por el valle de mis montes, porque ese valle llegará hasta Azal. {{plural_you:Huirán|Huiréis}} como huyeron {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} del terremoto cuando Uzías era rey de Judá. Después vendrá {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi Dios, y todos los santos estarán {{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}}.

fr.L: Et vous fuirez [par] la vallée de mes montagnes, car la vallée des montagnes atteindra Atsal ; et vous fuirez comme vous avez fui devant le tremblement de terre aux jours d’Ozias, roi de Juda ; et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu viendra, tous les saints avec {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Vous fuirez par la vallée de mes montagnes, car la vallée entre les montagnes s’étendra jusqu’à Atsal. Vous fuirez comme vous avez fui devant le tremblement de terre sous le règne d’Ozias, roi de Juda. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu viendra ; tous les saints seront avec {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Vous vous échapperez par la vallée de mes montagnes, car cette vallée s’étendra jusqu’à Atsal. Vous fuirez comme vos ancêtres ont fui devant le tremblement de terre quand Ozias était roi de Juda. Ensuite, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu viendra, et tous les saints seront avec {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Nanyi mtakimbia [kupitia] bonde la milima yangu, kwa maana bonde la milima litafika hadi Azali; nanyi mtakimbia kama mlivyokimbia mbele ya tetemeko la nchi katika siku za Uzia mfalme wa Yuda; na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu atakuja, watakatifu wote pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}.
sw.B: Mtakimbia kupitia bonde la milima yangu, kwa maana bonde kati ya milima litafika hadi Azali. Mtakimbia kama mlivyokimbia tetemeko la nchi wakati wa utawala wa Uzia mfalme wa Yuda. Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu atakuja; watakatifu wote watakuwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}.
sw.R: Mtatoroka kupitia bonde la milima yangu, kwa sababu bonde hilo litafika hadi Azali. Mtakimbia kama babu zenu walivyokimbia tetemeko la nchi wakati Uzia alipokuwa mfalme wa Yuda. Baada ya hayo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu atakuja, na watakatifu wote watakuwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}.

vi.L: Các ngươi sẽ chạy trốn [qua] thung lũng giữa các núi của ta, vì thung lũng của các núi sẽ kéo dài đến A-xên; các ngươi sẽ chạy trốn như các ngươi đã chạy trốn trước trận động đất trong đời Ô-xia vua Giu-đa; rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của tôi sẽ đến, mọi đấng thánh ở cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Các ngươi sẽ chạy trốn qua thung lũng giữa các núi của ta, vì thung lũng giữa các núi sẽ kéo dài đến tận A-xên. Các ngươi sẽ chạy trốn như đã chạy trốn trận động đất dưới triều Ô-xia vua Giu-đa. Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của tôi sẽ đến; mọi đấng thánh sẽ ở cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ trốn thoát qua thung lũng giữa các núi của ta, vì thung lũng ấy sẽ kéo dài đến tận A-xên. Các ngươi sẽ chạy trốn như tổ tiên các ngươi đã chạy trốn trận động đất khi Ô-xia làm vua Giu-đa. Sau đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của tôi sẽ đến, và mọi đấng thánh sẽ ở cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 너희가 내 산들의 골짜기로 도망할 것이다. 산들의 골짜기가 아셀까지 미칠 것이기 때문이다. 너희가 유다 왕 웃시야의 날에 지진을 피하여 도망한 것처럼 도망할 것이다. 그러면 나의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 오실 것이요, 모든 거룩한 이들이 주님과 함께 [있을 것이다].
ko.B: 너희는 내 산들 사이의 골짜기로 도망할 것이다. 그 골짜기가 아셀까지 이를 것이다. 너희는 유다 왕 웃시야가 다스리던 때에 지진을 피하여 도망한 것처럼 도망할 것이다. 그때에 나의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 오실 것이며, 모든 거룩한 이들이 주님과 함께 있을 것이다.
ko.R: 너희는 내 산들 사이의 골짜기로 피할 것이다. 그 골짜기가 아셀까지 이어질 것이다. 너희 조상들이 유다 왕 웃시야 때에 지진을 피해 도망한 것처럼 너희도 도망할 것이다. 그 뒤에 나의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 오실 것이다. 모든 거룩한 이들이 주님과 함께 있을 것이다.

decisions.choice: the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: the earthquake of Amos 1:1
decisions.reason: Amos 1:1 dates Amos's words "two years before the earthquake", in the reign of Uzziah, in the middle of the eighth century BC. It was still remembered more than two hundred years later, and so was the flight from it. The coming flight will be like that one.

decisions.choice: you will flee: the Hebrew text, against the reading "will be blocked"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "you will flee" three times. The Septuagint, with the Targum, read the same consonants with other vowels as "will be blocked": "the valley of my mountains will be blocked ... as it was blocked by the earthquake". The record follows the Hebrew, which fits the new valley of verse 4 as a way of escape.

decisions.choice: Azal: a place not otherwise known
decisions.reason: No place called Azal is known for certain. It may be Beth-ezel (Micah 1:11) or some place near Jerusalem, and some take the word as a common noun, "the side". The point is that the valley reaches far enough for the people to escape.

decisions.choice: the valley of my mountains: who says "my" is not clear
decisions.reason: The LORD calls the mountains of the land "my mountains" in Isaiah 14:25 and 49:11, and this may be the LORD speaking, as in verse 2. But the same verse goes on to say "the LORD my God", which is the prophet's voice. The text does not settle who says "my".

decisions.choice: all the holy ones with you: the Hebrew text, against "with him"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "with you", as if the prophet turns to speak to the LORD as he comes. The Septuagint and other ancient versions, and some Hebrew manuscripts, read "with him", which runs more smoothly. The holy ones are the heavenly beings who come with the LORD (Deuteronomy 33:2-3; Psalm 89:6, 8). 1 Thessalonians 3:13 speaks of the coming of the Lord Jesus "with all his holy ones", in words close to the Greek of this verse.

decisions.choice: my mountains (no setting); with you (deity_pronoun setting)
decisions.reason: "You" is the prophet speaking to the LORD (m5), so it takes the deity_pronoun setting. "My" in "my mountains" takes none, since a setting would decide who is speaking (m4). "My God" is the prophet's word and takes none.

decisions.choice: in the days of Uzziah (L); during the reign of Uzziah (B); while Uzziah was king (R); your ancestors (R)
decisions.reason: The date follows the wording of Amos 1:1 at each level (m1). Readable says "your ancestors", since those who fled the earthquake lived two centuries earlier.

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}}"; "mis montes" with no span; "Azal"
decisions.reason: The prophet turns to speak to the LORD (meaning decision m5), so "contigo" takes the setting; "mis" takes none, since a span would decide who speaks (m4). Azal is new in Spanish and keeps the English form.

decisions.choice: "avec {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}"; "mes montagnes" with no span; "Atsal"
decisions.reason: The prophet speaks to the LORD here (meaning decision m5), so "toi" takes the setting, while "mes" takes none (m4). "Atsal" follows the French spelling of *ts* (Mitspa, Tsoan).

decisions.choice: "pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}"; "milima yangu" with no span; "Azali"
decisions.reason: "Nawe" is the prophet speaking to the LORD (meaning decision m5) and takes the setting; "yangu" takes none (m4).

decisions.choice: "các núi của ta", lowercase with no span; "Đức Chúa Trời của tôi"; "ở cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}"
decisions.reason: The text does not say who calls the mountains "my" (meaning decision m4): "ta" without a span leaves it open, while "tôi" or a spanned "Ta" would decide it. The prophet then says "my God" and speaks to the LORD (m5). "Mọi đấng thánh" are the heavenly beings. Azal is new: "A-xên".

decisions.choice: "주님과 함께" for "with you"; "아셀"
decisions.reason: The prophet turns to speak to the LORD (meaning decision m5), and Korean speaks to God as "주님". Azal is new: "아셀".

source.text: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא לֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה א֔וֹר יְקָר֖וֹת וְקִפָּאֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be on that day [that] not will be light; splendid [ones] and frost.

en.L: And it will be in that day [that] there will be no light; the splendid [lights] will congeal.
en.B: On that day there will be no light; the shining lights will grow dim.
en.R: At that time there will be no light. The bright lights in the sky will fade.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día [que] no habrá luz; las [luces] espléndidas se cuajarán.
es.B: Aquel día no habrá luz; las luces brillantes se oscurecerán.
es.R: En ese tiempo no habrá luz. Las luces brillantes del cielo perderán su brillo.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là [qu’]il n’y aura pas de lumière ; les [astres] splendides se figeront.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, il n’y aura pas de lumière ; les astres brillants s’obscurciront.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, il n’y aura pas de lumière. Les lumières brillantes du ciel faibliront.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile hakutakuwa na nuru; [mianga] mitukufu itaganda.
sw.B: Siku hiyo hakutakuwa na nuru; mianga inayong'aa itafifia.
sw.R: Wakati huo hakutakuwa na nuru. Mianga inayong'aa angani itafifia.

vi.L: Sẽ xảy ra trong ngày ấy, sẽ không có ánh sáng; các [vì sáng] rực rỡ sẽ đông lại.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy sẽ không có ánh sáng; các vì sáng rực rỡ sẽ mờ đi.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy sẽ không có ánh sáng. Những vì sáng trên trời sẽ lu mờ.

ko.L: 그날에 이렇게 될 것이다. 빛이 없을 것이며, 찬란한 [빛들이] 엉길 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에는 빛이 없고, 빛나는 것들이 희미해질 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에는 빛이 없을 것이다. 하늘의 밝은 빛들이 흐려질 것이다.

decisions.choice: the splendid lights will congeal: a very uncertain text
decisions.reason: The last words are hard. The reading tradition (qere) has "splendid things and frost"; the written consonants (ketiv) can be read "the splendid ones will congeal", that is, the bright lights of the sky will thicken and grow dim. Job 31:26 uses the word "splendid" of the moon moving in its brightness. The Septuagint and other ancient versions read "there will be no light, and cold and frost". The record follows the written consonants, read as the lights growing dim.

decisions.choice: no light: the darkness of the day of the LORD
decisions.reason: The prophets say that the sun, moon and stars will be darkened on the day of the LORD (Isaiah 13:10; Joel 2:10; 3:4; 4:15; Amos 5:18-20; 8:9). Verse 7 goes on to say that on this day evening will bring light.

decisions.choice: will congeal (L); will grow dim (B); will fade (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of the verb, which is used of water thickening (Exodus 15:8); Balanced and Readable say what it means for light (m1). Readable says "in the sky".

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה יוֹם־אֶחָ֗ד ה֛וּא יִוָּדַ֥ע לַֽיהוָ֖ה לֹא־י֣וֹם וְלֹא־לָ֑יְלָה וְהָיָ֥ה לְעֵֽת־עֶ֖רֶב יִֽהְיֶה־אֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be one day — it is known to Yahweh — not day and not night; and it will be at [the] time of evening [that] there will be light.

en.L: And it will be one day, which is known to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, not day and not night; and it will be at evening time [that] there will be light.
en.B: It will be a day like no other, a day known to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, without day or night; and when evening comes, there will be light.
en.R: It will be a day unlike any other, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} knows that day. It will not be day and then night. When evening comes, there will still be light.

es.L: Y será un día único, conocido por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ni día ni noche; y sucederá [que] a la hora de la tarde habrá luz.
es.B: Será un día sin igual, un día que conoce {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, sin día ni noche; y cuando llegue la tarde, habrá luz.
es.R: Será un día distinto de todos los demás, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} conoce ese día. No habrá día y luego noche. Cuando llegue la tarde, todavía habrá luz.

fr.L: Et ce sera un jour unique, il est connu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, ni jour ni nuit ; et il arrivera au temps du soir [qu’]il y aura de la lumière.
fr.B: Ce sera un jour sans pareil, un jour connu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, sans jour ni nuit ; et quand viendra le soir, il y aura de la lumière.
fr.R: Ce sera un jour différent de tous les autres, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} connaît ce jour-là. Il n’y aura pas le jour puis la nuit. Quand le soir viendra, il fera encore clair.

sw.L: Nayo itakuwa siku moja, inayojulikana kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, si mchana wala si usiku; na itakuwa wakati wa jioni kutakuwa na nuru.
sw.B: Itakuwa siku isiyo na mfano wake, siku inayojulikana na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, bila mchana wala usiku; na jioni itakapofika, kutakuwa na nuru.
sw.R: Itakuwa siku tofauti na siku nyingine zote, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaijua siku hiyo. Hakutakuwa na mchana kisha usiku. Jioni itakapofika, bado kutakuwa na nuru.

vi.L: Đó sẽ là một ngày duy nhất, được {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} biết đến, không phải ngày cũng không phải đêm; và sẽ xảy ra vào lúc chiều tối [là] sẽ có ánh sáng.
vi.B: Đó sẽ là một ngày có một không hai, một ngày {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} biết rõ, không có ngày cũng không có đêm; và khi chiều đến, vẫn có ánh sáng.
vi.R: Đó sẽ là một ngày khác hẳn mọi ngày, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} biết ngày ấy. Sẽ không có chuyện ngày qua rồi đêm đến. Khi chiều đến, vẫn còn ánh sáng.

ko.L: 그날은 한 날이 될 것이니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 아시는 날이다. 낮도 아니고 밤도 아닐 것이다. 저녁때가 되어도 빛이 있을 것이다.
ko.B: 그날은 다시없는 날, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 아시는 날이 될 것이다. 낮도 밤도 없고, 저녁이 되어도 빛이 있을 것이다.
ko.R: 그날은 다른 어떤 날과도 다른 날이 될 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그날을 아신다. 낮이 지나고 밤이 오는 일이 없을 것이다. 저녁이 되어도 여전히 밝을 것이다.

decisions.choice: one day: a single, unique day
decisions.reason: "One day" can mean a day that is one of a kind (compare Ezekiel 7:5, "a disaster, a unique disaster"). It recalls the first day of creation, which Genesis 1:5 calls "one day": there God divided light from darkness and day from night; here there is no such division. Some take "one day" as one unbroken day.

decisions.choice: it is known to the LORD: the LORD knows that day
decisions.reason: The words stand as an aside. They may mean that the LORD knows when the day will come, or that the day is the LORD's and its nature is known to him, beyond human reckoning. Compare Matthew 24:36, where Jesus says that no one knows that day or hour but the Father.

decisions.choice: not day and not night; at evening there will be light: a new order of time
decisions.reason: God set day and night in their order and promised that they would not cease while the earth lasts (Genesis 8:22; Jeremiah 33:20). On this day the order changes: evening does not bring darkness. Isaiah 60:19-20 promises that the LORD will be his people's everlasting light, and Revelation 21:25 and 22:5 say that there will be no night in the new Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: a day like no other (B); a day unlike any other (R); without day or night (B); not day and then night (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "one day" means here (m1). Readable explains "not day and not night" as the end of the change from day to night, which the next words describe.

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה׀בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יֵצְא֤וּ מַֽיִם־חַיִּים֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם חֶצְיָ֗ם אֶל־הַיָּם֙ הַקַּדְמוֹנִ֔י וְחֶצְיָ֖ם אֶל־הַיָּ֣ם הָאַחֲר֑וֹן בַּקַּ֥יִץ וּבָחֹ֖רֶף יִֽהְיֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be on that day [that] will go out living waters from Jerusalem, half of them to the eastern sea and half of them to the western sea; in summer and in winter it will be.

en.L: And it will be in that day [that] living waters will go forth from Jerusalem, half of them to the eastern sea and half of them to the western sea; in summer and in winter it will be [so].
en.B: On that day living water will flow out of Jerusalem, half of it to the eastern sea and half of it to the western sea. It will flow in summer and in winter alike.
en.R: At that time living water will flow out from Jerusalem. Half of it will flow east to the Dead Sea, and half of it west to the Mediterranean Sea. It will keep flowing all year round, in summer and in winter.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día [que] saldrán aguas vivas de Jerusalén, la mitad de ellas hacia el mar oriental y la mitad de ellas hacia el mar occidental; en verano y en invierno será [así].
es.B: Aquel día brotará agua viva de Jerusalén, la mitad hacia el mar oriental y la mitad hacia el mar occidental. Correrá en verano y en invierno.
es.R: En ese tiempo saldrá agua viva de Jerusalén. La mitad correrá hacia el este, al mar Muerto, y la otra mitad hacia el oeste, al mar Mediterráneo. Seguirá corriendo todo el año, en verano y en invierno.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là [que] des eaux vives sortiront de Jérusalem, la moitié vers la mer orientale et la moitié vers la mer occidentale ; en été et en hiver il en sera [ainsi].
fr.B: Ce jour-là, de l’eau vive jaillira de Jérusalem, une moitié vers la mer orientale et l’autre moitié vers la mer occidentale. Elle coulera été comme hiver.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, de l’eau vive sortira de Jérusalem. Une moitié coulera vers l’est, jusqu’à la mer Morte, et l’autre moitié vers l’ouest, jusqu’à la Méditerranée. Elle coulera toute l’année, en été comme en hiver.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, maji yaliyo hai yatatoka Yerusalemu, nusu yake kuelekea bahari ya mashariki na nusu yake kuelekea bahari ya magharibi; wakati wa kiangazi na wakati wa masika itakuwa [hivyo].
sw.B: Siku hiyo maji yaliyo hai yatatiririka kutoka Yerusalemu, nusu yake kuelekea bahari ya mashariki na nusu yake kuelekea bahari ya magharibi. Yatatiririka wakati wa kiangazi na wakati wa masika vilevile.
sw.R: Wakati huo maji yaliyo hai yatatiririka kutoka Yerusalemu. Nusu yake yatatiririka mashariki hadi Bahari ya Chumvi, na nusu nyingine magharibi hadi Bahari ya Mediterania. Yataendelea kutiririka mwaka mzima, wakati wa kiangazi na wakati wa masika.

vi.L: Sẽ xảy ra trong ngày ấy, nước sống sẽ tuôn ra từ Giê-ru-sa-lem, một nửa chảy về biển phía đông và một nửa chảy về biển phía tây; mùa hạ cũng như mùa đông đều [như vậy].
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, nước sống sẽ tuôn chảy từ Giê-ru-sa-lem, một nửa về biển phía đông và một nửa về biển phía tây. Nước sẽ chảy cả mùa hạ lẫn mùa đông.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, nước sống sẽ chảy ra từ Giê-ru-sa-lem. Một nửa chảy về phía đông, ra Biển Chết, và một nửa chảy về phía tây, ra Địa Trung Hải. Nước sẽ chảy quanh năm, cả mùa hè lẫn mùa đông.

ko.L: 그날에 이렇게 될 것이다. 생수가 예루살렘에서 흘러나와, 그 절반은 동쪽 바다로, 그 절반은 서쪽 바다로 흐를 것이다. 여름에도 겨울에도 그러할 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 생수가 예루살렘에서 흘러나와, 절반은 동쪽 바다로, 절반은 서쪽 바다로 흐를 것이다. 여름에나 겨울에나 흐를 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 생수가 예루살렘에서 흘러나올 것이다. 절반은 동쪽 사해로, 절반은 서쪽 지중해로 흘러갈 것이다. 그 물은 여름에도 겨울에도 일 년 내내 흐를 것이다.

decisions.choice: living waters: fresh, flowing water that gives life
decisions.reason: "Living water" is running water from a spring or stream, not the still water of a cistern (Genesis 26:19; Leviticus 14:5). Jeremiah 2:13 calls the LORD "the spring of living water". The phrase also means water that gives life, as the river of Ezekiel 47 brings life wherever it goes.

decisions.choice: the eastern sea and the western sea: the Dead Sea and the Mediterranean
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the front sea", the one in front of a person who faces east, and "the back sea". They are the Dead Sea to the east of Jerusalem and the Mediterranean to the west, as in Joel 2:20. In a dry land where most streams fail in summer (Jeremiah 15:18; Job 6:15-17), water that flows summer and winter is a great gift.

decisions.choice: water flowing from Jerusalem: Ezekiel 47, Joel 4:18 and Revelation 22:1
decisions.reason: Ezekiel 47:1-12 sees a river flowing out from the temple east to the Dead Sea and making its salt water fresh. Joel 4:18 sees a spring flowing out from the LORD's house. Revelation 22:1 shows the river of the water of life flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb in the new Jerusalem. On the last day of the Festival of Booths, the festival named in verses 16-19, Jesus spoke of rivers of living water (John 7:37-38). See also 13:1.

decisions.choice: living waters (L); living water (B, R); the Dead Sea, the Mediterranean Sea (R)
decisions.reason: "Living water" is kept at every level, so that the reader can follow the picture into John 7:38 and Revelation 22:1 (m3); Balanced and Readable use the singular, as English does for water. Readable names the two seas (m2) and says "all year round".

decisions.choice: "aguas vivas" (L); "agua viva" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words of the published John 7:38 ("agua viva"), so the picture can be followed into the New Testament (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: "des eaux vives" (L); "de l'eau vive" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words of the published John 7:38 ("eau vive"), as meaning decision m3 asks.

decisions.choice: "maji yaliyo hai"; "kiangazi" and "masika" for summer and winter
decisions.reason: "Maji yaliyo hai" is the published John 7:38 (meaning decision m3). The land's winter is its rainy season, which East Africa knows as "masika".

decisions.choice: "nước sống"
decisions.reason: The words of the published John 7:38 ("nước sống"), as meaning decision m3 asks.

decisions.choice: "생수"
decisions.reason: The word of the published John 7:38 ("생수의 강들"), as meaning decision m3 asks.

source.text: וְהָיָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִהְיֶ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶחָ֖ד וּשְׁמ֥וֹ אֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be Yahweh king over all the earth; on that day will be Yahweh one, and his name one.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be king over all the earth; in that day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be one, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name one.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will be king over all the earth. On that day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be one, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name one.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will be king over the whole earth. At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be one, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name will be one.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será rey sobre toda la tierra; en aquel día {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será uno, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre uno.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será rey sobre toda la tierra. Aquel día {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será uno, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre uno.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será rey sobre toda la tierra. En ese tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será uno, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre será uno.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera roi sur toute la terre ; en ce jour-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera un, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom un.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera roi sur toute la terre. Ce jour-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera un, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom un.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera roi sur toute la terre. En ce temps-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera un, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom sera un.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa mfalme juu ya dunia yote; katika siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa mmoja, na jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} moja.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa mfalme juu ya dunia yote. Siku hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa mmoja, na jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} moja.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa mfalme wa dunia nzima. Wakati huo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa mmoja, na jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} litakuwa moja.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ làm vua trên khắp đất; trong ngày ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ là một, và danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là một.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ làm vua trên khắp đất. Vào ngày ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ là duy nhất, và danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là duy nhất.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ làm vua trên cả trái đất. Vào lúc ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ là duy nhất, và danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ là duy nhất.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 온 땅의 왕이 되실 것이다. 그날에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하나이시고, 그분의 이름도 하나일 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 온 땅을 다스리는 왕이 되실 것이다. 그날에는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 한 분이시고, 그분의 이름도 하나일 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 온 세상의 왕이 되실 것이다. 그때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 한 분이실 것이고, 그분의 이름도 하나일 것이다.

decisions.choice: the LORD will be one, and his name one: the words of Deuteronomy 6:4
decisions.reason: The words take up Israel's confession, "Hear, Israel: the LORD our God, the LORD is one" (Deuteronomy 6:4). What Israel confesses will then be true for the whole earth: the LORD alone will be worshiped as God, and his name alone will be called on, with no other gods named beside him (13:2; Zephaniah 3:9). As in Deuteronomy 6:4, "one" can mean both "one" and "the only one".

decisions.choice: the LORD will be king over all the earth
decisions.reason: The psalms praise the LORD as "a great king over all the earth" (Psalm 47:3, 8; 96:10; 97:1). On that day his rule will be seen by all. Verses 16-17 call him "the King, the LORD of hosts", to whom the nations come to bow down; the king who comes to Zion in 9:9 is spoken of in the same book.

decisions.choice: the LORD will be one, and his name one (L, B); and his name will be one (R)
decisions.reason: The words follow Deuteronomy 6:4 as published ("the LORD is one") at each level. Readable stays close to Balanced, adding only "will be", since any plainer wording would have to choose between "one" and "only", as the notes at Deuteronomy 6:4 also say (m1). "His" takes the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: "là một" (L); "là duy nhất" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the published Deuteronomy 6:4 at each level, which this verse takes up (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "하나이시고" (L); "한 분이시고" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the published Deuteronomy 6:4 at each level (meaning decision m1); the name is "하나" at every level.

source.text: יִסּ֨וֹב כָּל־הָאָ֤רֶץ כָּעֲרָבָה֙ מִגֶּ֣בַע לְרִמּ֔וֹן נֶ֖גֶב יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְֽרָאֲמָה֩ וְיָשְׁבָ֨ה תַחְתֶּ֜יהָ לְמִשַּׁ֣עַר בִּנְיָמִ֗ן עַד־מְק֞וֹם שַׁ֤עַר הָֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ עַד־שַׁ֣עַר הַפִּנִּ֔ים וּמִגְדַּ֣ל חֲנַנְאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד יִקְבֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Will be changed all the land like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon, south of Jerusalem; and she will be high and will dwell in her place, from [the] Gate of Benjamin to [the] place of the First Gate, to [the] Gate of the Corners, and [the] Tower of Hananel to the winepresses of the king.

en.L: All the land will be turned [into something] like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; but she will be raised high and will remain in her place, from the Gate of Benjamin to the place of the First Gate, to the Gate of the Corners, and [from] the Tower of Hananel to the king's winepresses.
en.B: The whole land will become like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem. But Jerusalem will stand high and remain on its own site, from the Benjamin Gate to the site of the First Gate and on to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel as far as the royal winepresses.
en.R: All the land from Geba in the north to Rimmon south of Jerusalem will become flat, like the Jordan Valley. But Jerusalem will be raised up high, and it will stay where it is. It will reach from the Benjamin Gate to the place of the First Gate and the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel down to the king's winepresses.

es.L: Toda la tierra se volverá como el Arabá, desde Geba hasta Rimón, al sur de Jerusalén; pero ella será elevada y habitará en su lugar, desde la puerta de Benjamín hasta el lugar de la puerta Primera, hasta la puerta de las Esquinas, y [desde] la torre de Hananel hasta los lagares del rey.
es.B: Toda la tierra se volverá como el Arabá, desde Geba hasta Rimón, al sur de Jerusalén. Pero Jerusalén se alzará en lo alto y permanecerá en su sitio, desde la puerta de Benjamín hasta el lugar de la puerta Primera y hasta la puerta del Ángulo, y desde la torre de Hananel hasta los lagares del rey.
es.R: Toda la tierra, desde Geba en el norte hasta Rimón al sur de Jerusalén, quedará llana como el valle del Jordán. Pero Jerusalén será levantada en alto y seguirá en su lugar. Se extenderá desde la puerta de Benjamín hasta el lugar de la puerta Primera y la puerta del Ángulo, y desde la torre de Hananel hasta los lagares del rey.

fr.L: Tout le pays deviendra comme l’Araba, de Guéba à Rimmôn, au sud de Jérusalem ; mais elle sera élevée et demeurera à sa place, depuis la porte de Benjamin jusqu’à l’emplacement de la Première Porte, jusqu’à la porte des Angles, et [depuis] la tour de Hananéel jusqu’aux pressoirs du roi.
fr.B: Tout le pays deviendra comme l’Araba, de Guéba à Rimmôn, au sud de Jérusalem. Mais Jérusalem se dressera bien haut et restera sur son site, depuis la porte de Benjamin jusqu’à l’emplacement de la Première Porte et jusqu’à la porte de l’Angle, et depuis la tour de Hananéel jusqu’aux pressoirs du roi.
fr.R: Tout le pays, de Guéba au nord jusqu’à Rimmôn au sud de Jérusalem, deviendra plat comme la vallée du Jourdain. Mais Jérusalem sera élevée bien haut et restera où elle est. Elle s’étendra de la porte de Benjamin jusqu’à l’endroit de la Première Porte et à la porte de l’Angle, et de la tour de Hananéel jusqu’aux pressoirs du roi.

sw.L: Nchi yote itageuka kuwa kama Araba, kutoka Geba mpaka Rimoni kusini mwa Yerusalemu; lakini [mji] utainuliwa juu na kukaa mahali pake, kutoka Lango la Benyamini mpaka mahali pa Lango la Kwanza, mpaka Lango la Pembe, na [kutoka] Mnara wa Hananeli mpaka mashinikizo ya divai ya mfalme.
sw.B: Nchi yote itakuwa kama Araba, kutoka Geba mpaka Rimoni kusini mwa Yerusalemu. Lakini Yerusalemu utasimama juu na kubaki mahali pake, kutoka Lango la Benyamini mpaka mahali pa Lango la Kwanza na mpaka Lango la Pembeni, na kutoka Mnara wa Hananeli mpaka mashinikizo ya divai ya mfalme.
sw.R: Nchi yote, kutoka Geba upande wa kaskazini mpaka Rimoni kusini mwa Yerusalemu, itakuwa tambarare kama bonde la Yordani. Lakini Yerusalemu utainuliwa juu, nao utabaki mahali ulipo. Utaenea kutoka Lango la Benyamini mpaka mahali pa Lango la Kwanza na Lango la Pembeni, na kutoka Mnara wa Hananeli mpaka mashinikizo ya divai ya mfalme.

vi.L: Cả xứ sẽ biến thành như A-ra-ba, từ Ghê-ba đến Rim-môn ở phía nam Giê-ru-sa-lem; nhưng thành sẽ được nhấc cao lên và ở yên tại chỗ mình, từ Cổng Bên-gia-min đến chỗ Cổng Thứ Nhất, đến Cổng Góc, và [từ] tháp Ha-na-nên đến các bồn ép nho của vua.
vi.B: Cả xứ sẽ trở nên như đồng bằng A-ra-ba, từ Ghê-ba đến Rim-môn ở phía nam Giê-ru-sa-lem. Nhưng Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ đứng sừng sững trên cao và vẫn ở tại chỗ cũ, từ Cổng Bên-gia-min đến chỗ Cổng Thứ Nhất và đến Cổng Góc, từ tháp Ha-na-nên đến các bồn ép nho của vua.
vi.R: Cả xứ, từ Ghê-ba ở phía bắc đến Rim-môn ở phía nam Giê-ru-sa-lem, sẽ trở nên bằng phẳng như thung lũng sông Giô-đanh. Nhưng Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ được nâng cao lên và vẫn ở tại chỗ cũ. Thành sẽ trải dài từ Cổng Bên-gia-min đến chỗ Cổng Thứ Nhất và Cổng Góc, từ tháp Ha-na-nên đến các bồn ép nho của vua.

ko.L: 온 땅이 게바에서 예루살렘 남쪽 림몬까지 아라바처럼 변할 것이다. 그러나 그 성은 높이 솟아 제자리에 있을 것이니, 베냐민 문에서 첫 문 자리까지, 모퉁이 문들까지, 그리고 하나넬 망대에서 왕의 포도주 틀까지이다.
ko.B: 게바에서 예루살렘 남쪽 림몬까지 온 땅이 아라바처럼 될 것이다. 그러나 예루살렘은 높이 솟아 제자리에 그대로 있을 것이다. 베냐민 문에서 첫 문이 있던 자리를 지나 모퉁이 문까지, 하나넬 망대에서 왕의 포도주 틀까지 이를 것이다.
ko.R: 북쪽 게바에서 예루살렘 남쪽 림몬까지 온 땅이 요단 골짜기처럼 평평해질 것이다. 그러나 예루살렘은 높이 들려서 그 자리에 그대로 있을 것이다. 그 성은 베냐민 문에서 첫 문 자리와 모퉁이 문까지, 하나넬 망대에서 왕의 포도주 틀까지 펼쳐질 것이다.

decisions.choice: like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon: the hill country of Judah made flat
decisions.reason: The Arabah is the deep, flat valley of the Jordan and the Dead Sea, running on south to the Gulf of Aqaba. Geba lay about six miles north of Jerusalem and marked the northern edge of Judah (2 Kings 23:8, "from Geba to Beersheba"). Rimmon is most likely En-rimmon in the far south (Joshua 15:32; Nehemiah 11:29). The hills of Judah between them will be levelled.

decisions.choice: she will be raised high and will remain in her place: Jerusalem lifted above the land
decisions.reason: "She" is Jerusalem. As the land around is levelled, the city stands high, like the mountain of the LORD's house raised above the hills in Isaiah 2:2 and Micah 4:1. To "remain in her place" is to be lived in again on her old site, as 12:6 says.

decisions.choice: the gates, the tower and the winepresses: the bounds of the city
decisions.reason: The places mark the city's full extent. The Gate of Benjamin was in the north wall (Jeremiah 37:13; 38:7). The Corner Gate was at the northwest corner (2 Kings 14:13; Jeremiah 31:38). The Tower of Hananel stood in the north wall (Jeremiah 31:38; Nehemiah 3:1). The king's winepresses were probably in the south, near the king's garden (Nehemiah 3:15). The First Gate is not named elsewhere, and its place is unknown. Jeremiah 31:38-40 also promises that the city will be rebuilt from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.

decisions.choice: like the Jordan Valley; in the north (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "the Jordan Valley" for the Arabah, which most readers will not know, and "in the north" for Geba, to show that the two places mark the length of the land (m1). Balanced says "Jerusalem" for "she".

decisions.choice: "la puerta de las Esquinas" (L); "la puerta del Ángulo" (B, R); "la torre de Hananel"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew plural "corners"; Balanced and Readable use the published name of Jeremiah 31:38 and 2 Kings 14:13 (meaning decision m3). The First Gate is not named elsewhere.

decisions.choice: "la porte des Angles" (L); "la porte de l'Angle" (B, R); "la tour de Hananéel"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew plural; Balanced and Readable use the published name of Jeremiah 31:38 (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: "Lango la Pembe" (L); "Lango la Pembeni" (B, R); "Mnara wa Hananeli"; "Lango la Kwanza"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the published names of Jeremiah 31:38 and 37:13 (meaning decision m3); Literal keeps the plural "corners" closer. "Yerusalemu" agrees as "mji" (u-).

decisions.choice: "Cổng Góc"; "tháp Ha-na-nên"; "Cổng Bên-gia-min"; "Cổng Thứ Nhất"
decisions.reason: The published names of Jeremiah 31:38 and 37:13 (meaning decision m3); the First Gate is new and is translated.

decisions.choice: "모퉁이 문"; "하나넬 망대"; "베냐민 문"; "첫 문"
decisions.reason: The published names of Jeremiah 31:38 and 37:13 (meaning decision m3); Literal keeps the Hebrew plural, "모퉁이 문들".

source.text: וְיָ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔הּ וְחֵ֖רֶם לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶה־ע֑וֹד וְיָשְׁבָ֥ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לָבֶֽטַח׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will dwell in her, and destruction not will be again; and will dwell Jerusalem in security.

en.L: And they will dwell in her, and there will no longer be a ban of destruction; and Jerusalem will dwell in security.
en.B: People will live in it, and it will never again be devoted to destruction. Jerusalem will live in safety.
en.R: People will live in Jerusalem, and it will never again be doomed to destruction. The city will be safe.

es.L: Y habitarán en ella, y no habrá más anatema de destrucción; y Jerusalén habitará segura.
es.B: La gente vivirá en ella, y nunca más será consagrada a la destrucción. Jerusalén vivirá segura.
es.R: La gente vivirá en Jerusalén, y nunca más será condenada a la destrucción. La ciudad estará a salvo.

fr.L: Et on habitera en elle, et il n’y aura plus d’anathème ; et Jérusalem habitera en sécurité.
fr.B: On y habitera, et elle ne sera plus jamais vouée à la destruction. Jérusalem vivra en sécurité.
fr.R: Des gens habiteront à Jérusalem, et elle ne sera plus jamais condamnée à être détruite. La ville sera en sécurité.

sw.L: Nao watakaa ndani yake, wala hakutakuwa tena na laana ya maangamizi; na Yerusalemu utakaa salama.
sw.B: Watu wataishi ndani yake, wala hautawekwa wakfu tena kwa maangamizi. Yerusalemu utaishi kwa usalama.
sw.R: Watu wataishi Yerusalemu, wala hautahukumiwa tena kuangamizwa. Mji utakuwa salama.

vi.L: Người ta sẽ ở trong thành, và sẽ không còn án hủy diệt nữa; Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ được ở yên ổn.
vi.B: Người ta sẽ sống trong thành, và thành sẽ không bao giờ bị dâng cho sự hủy diệt nữa. Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ được an ninh.
vi.R: Người ta sẽ sống ở Giê-ru-sa-lem, và thành sẽ không bao giờ bị kết án hủy diệt nữa. Thành sẽ được an toàn.

ko.L: 사람들이 그 안에 살 것이며, 다시는 진멸의 저주가 없을 것이다. 예루살렘이 안전하게 머물 것이다.
ko.B: 사람들이 그곳에 살 것이며, 다시는 그 성이 진멸에 바쳐지지 않을 것이다. 예루살렘은 평안히 살 것이다.
ko.R: 사람들이 예루살렘에 살 것이며, 다시는 그 성이 멸망당할 운명에 놓이지 않을 것이다. 그 성은 안전할 것이다.

decisions.choice: destruction: the ban, total destruction given over to God
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for things or peoples "devoted" to God for complete destruction, as Jericho was (Joshua 6:17-18), and for the curse with which Malachi 3:24 closes the prophets. Jerusalem itself had been given over to such judgment (Isaiah 43:28). Never again will that happen to the city. Revelation 22:3 says of the new Jerusalem that there will no longer be any curse.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem will dwell in security
decisions.reason: Living in safety is the covenant blessing of Leviticus 25:18-19 and 26:5, and it is promised again to restored Israel (Jeremiah 23:6; 33:16; Ezekiel 34:25-28).

decisions.choice: a ban of destruction (L); devoted to destruction (B); doomed to destruction (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the sense of something given over to God to be destroyed (m1); Readable says "doomed".

source.text: וְזֹ֣את׀תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה הַמַּגֵּפָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִגֹּ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶת־כָּל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צָבְא֖וּ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הָמֵ֣ק׀בְּשָׂר֗וֹ וְהוּא֙ עֹמֵ֣ד עַל־רַגְלָ֔יו וְעֵינָיו֙ תִּמַּ֣קְנָה בְחֹֽרֵיהֶ֔ן וּלְשׁוֹנ֖וֹ תִּמַּ֥ק בְּפִיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And this will be the plague with which will strike Yahweh all the peoples who have waged war against Jerusalem: making rot his flesh while he [is] standing on his feet, and his eyes will rot in their sockets, and his tongue will rot in their mouth.

en.L: And this will be the plague with which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike all the peoples who have waged war against Jerusalem: their flesh will rot while they are standing on their feet, and their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongue will rot in their mouth.
en.B: This is the plague with which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike all the peoples who made war on Jerusalem: their flesh will rot while they are still on their feet; their eyes will rot in their sockets; their tongues will rot in their mouths.
en.R: This is the plague {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will send on all the nations that fought against Jerusalem. Their flesh will rot while they are still standing up. Their eyes will rot in their sockets. Their tongues will rot in their mouths.

es.L: Y esta será la plaga con que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} herirá a todos los pueblos que hicieron guerra contra Jerusalén: su carne se pudrirá estando ellos de pie sobre sus pies, y sus ojos se pudrirán en sus cuencas, y su lengua se pudrirá en su boca.
es.B: Esta es la plaga con que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} herirá a todos los pueblos que hicieron guerra contra Jerusalén: su carne se pudrirá mientras aún estén de pie; sus ojos se pudrirán en sus cuencas; sus lenguas se pudrirán en sus bocas.
es.R: Esta es la plaga que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} enviará sobre todas las naciones que pelearon contra Jerusalén. Su carne se pudrirá mientras todavía estén de pie. Sus ojos se pudrirán en sus cuencas. Sus lenguas se pudrirán en sus bocas.

fr.L: Et voici quelle sera la plaie dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappera tous les peuples qui ont fait la guerre contre Jérusalem : leur chair pourrira pendant qu’ils se tiennent sur leurs pieds, et leurs yeux pourriront dans leurs orbites, et leur langue pourrira dans leur bouche.
fr.B: Voici la plaie dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappera tous les peuples qui ont fait la guerre à Jérusalem : leur chair pourrira alors qu’ils seront encore debout ; leurs yeux pourriront dans leurs orbites ; leur langue pourrira dans leur bouche.
fr.R: Voici le fléau que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} enverra sur toutes les nations qui ont combattu contre Jérusalem. Leur chair pourrira alors qu’ils seront encore debout. Leurs yeux pourriront dans leurs orbites. Leur langue pourrira dans leur bouche.

sw.L: Na hii itakuwa tauni ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atayapiga nayo mataifa yote yaliyofanya vita juu ya Yerusalemu: nyama yao itaoza wakiwa wamesimama kwa miguu yao, na macho yao yataoza katika matundu yake, na ulimi wao utaoza katika kinywa chao.
sw.B: Hii ndiyo tauni ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawapiga nayo watu wote waliopigana vita dhidi ya Yerusalemu: miili yao itaoza wakiwa bado wamesimama; macho yao yataoza katika matundu yake; ndimi zao zitaoza vinywani mwao.
sw.R: Hii ndiyo tauni ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atayaletea mataifa yote yaliyopigana na Yerusalemu. Miili yao itaoza wakiwa bado wamesimama. Macho yao yataoza katika matundu yake. Ndimi zao zitaoza vinywani mwao.

vi.L: Đây sẽ là tai vạ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dùng để đánh mọi dân đã gây chiến với Giê-ru-sa-lem: thịt của chúng sẽ thối rữa khi chúng còn đứng trên chân mình, mắt chúng sẽ thối rữa trong hốc, và lưỡi chúng sẽ thối rữa trong miệng.
vi.B: Đây là tai vạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giáng trên mọi dân đã gây chiến với Giê-ru-sa-lem: thịt chúng sẽ thối rữa khi chúng còn đứng; mắt chúng sẽ thối rữa trong hốc; lưỡi chúng sẽ thối rữa trong miệng.
vi.R: Đây là tai vạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giáng xuống mọi nước đã đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem. Thịt chúng sẽ thối rữa khi chúng vẫn còn đứng. Mắt chúng sẽ thối rữa trong hốc mắt. Lưỡi chúng sẽ thối rữa trong miệng.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예루살렘을 치려고 싸운 모든 민족을 치실 재앙은 이러하다. 그들이 발로 서 있는 동안에 그 살이 썩고, 그 눈이 눈구멍 속에서 썩고, 그 혀가 입 속에서 썩을 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예루살렘과 싸운 모든 민족을 치실 재앙은 이러하다. 그들이 아직 서 있는 동안에 살이 썩고, 눈이 눈구멍 속에서 썩고, 혀가 입 속에서 썩을 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예루살렘과 싸운 모든 민족에게 내리실 재앙은 이러하다. 그들이 아직 서 있는데도 살이 썩을 것이다. 눈이 눈구멍 속에서 썩을 것이다. 혀가 입 속에서 썩을 것이다.

decisions.choice: the plague: a blow from the LORD
decisions.reason: The word for "plague" comes from the verb "strike", used just after it. It is used of the blows the LORD sent on Egypt (Exodus 9:14) and on Israel in the wilderness (Numbers 14:37; 17:13-15). The verse says what the plague does, and no more.

decisions.choice: his flesh ... their mouth: the Hebrew speaks of each one
decisions.reason: The Hebrew moves between the singular ("his flesh", "he is standing", "his eyes", "his tongue") and the plural ("their sockets", "their mouth"). It means that the plague strikes each one of the enemy. The first verb is causative, "making his flesh rot": the LORD is the cause. The flesh rots "while he is standing on his feet", before the body has fallen.

decisions.choice: the LORD strikes the peoples who attacked Jerusalem
decisions.reason: When the Assyrian army besieged Jerusalem in Hezekiah's day, the angel of the LORD struck it down in one night (2 Kings 19:35; Isaiah 37:36). Here the LORD strikes the peoples who have made war on the city.

decisions.choice: their flesh ... their tongue (L); their tongues ... their mouths (B, R)
decisions.reason: Every level says "their" for the Hebrew singular (m2), and Literal keeps the Hebrew "tongue" and "mouth" in the singular. No level adds to what the Hebrew says the plague does. "Rot" is kept three times, as the Hebrew repeats its verb.

source.text: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא תִּֽהְיֶ֧ה מְהֽוּמַת־יְהוָ֛ה רַבָּ֖ה בָּהֶ֑ם וְהֶחֱזִ֗יקוּ אִ֚ישׁ יַ֣ד רֵעֵ֔הוּ וְעָלְתָ֥ה יָד֖וֹ עַל־יַ֥ד רֵעֵֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be on that day [that] will be a panic of Yahweh great among them; and they will seize each [the] hand of his fellow, and will go up his hand against [the] hand of his fellow.

en.L: And it will be in that day [that] a great panic from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be among them; and they will seize each the hand of his fellow, and his hand will rise against the hand of his fellow.
en.B: On that day a great panic from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will fall on them. They will seize one another by the hand, and each will raise a hand against the other.
en.R: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will throw them into great panic. They will grab hold of one another and attack each other.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día [que] habrá entre ellos un gran pánico de parte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y agarrarán cada uno la mano de su compañero, y su mano se levantará contra la mano de su compañero.
es.B: Aquel día un gran pánico enviado por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} caerá sobre ellos. Se agarrarán unos a otros de la mano, y cada uno levantará la mano contra el otro.
es.R: En ese tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los llenará de un gran pánico. Se agarrarán unos a otros y se atacarán entre sí.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là [qu’]il y aura parmi eux une grande panique venant {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; et ils saisiront chacun la main de son compagnon, et sa main se lèvera contre la main de son compagnon.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, une grande panique venant {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’abattra sur eux. Ils se saisiront les uns les autres par la main, et chacun lèvera la main contre l’autre.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les jettera dans une grande panique. Ils s’agripperont les uns aux autres et s’attaqueront entre eux.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, kutakuwa na fadhaa kuu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} miongoni mwao; nao watakamata kila mmoja mkono wa mwenzake, na mkono wake utainuka juu ya mkono wa mwenzake.
sw.B: Siku hiyo fadhaa kuu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} itawaangukia. Watakamatana mikono wao kwa wao, na kila mmoja atainua mkono wake dhidi ya mwenzake.
sw.R: Wakati huo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatia katika fadhaa kuu. Watakamatana na kushambuliana wao kwa wao.

vi.L: Sẽ xảy ra trong ngày ấy, một sự hoảng loạn lớn từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ ở giữa chúng; mỗi người sẽ nắm lấy tay đồng bọn mình, và tay nó sẽ giơ lên nghịch cùng tay đồng bọn mình.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giáng trên chúng một sự hoảng loạn lớn. Chúng sẽ túm lấy tay nhau, và người này giơ tay đánh người kia.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ làm cho chúng hoảng loạn tột độ. Chúng sẽ túm lấy nhau và tấn công lẫn nhau.

ko.L: 그날에 이렇게 될 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보내신 큰 혼란이 그들 가운데 있을 것이다. 그들이 저마다 제 이웃의 손을 붙잡고, 제 손을 들어 이웃의 손을 칠 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들 가운데 큰 혼란을 일으키실 것이다. 그들은 서로 손을 붙잡고, 저마다 손을 들어 서로를 칠 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 큰 혼란에 빠뜨리실 것이다. 그들은 서로 붙잡고 서로를 공격할 것이다.

decisions.choice: a great panic from the LORD: the enemy turns on itself
decisions.reason: The LORD threw the enemies of his people into great confusion (Deuteronomy 7:23; 1 Samuel 14:20). In Gideon's battle and in Jehoshaphat's the enemy armies destroyed one another (Judges 7:22; 2 Chronicles 20:23), and Ezekiel 38:21 says the same of the army of Gog.

decisions.choice: seize the hand of his fellow, and raise his hand against his fellow's hand: they fight one another
decisions.reason: To seize someone's hand can be to grapple with him, and to raise one's hand against someone is to attack him (2 Samuel 18:28; 20:21). In the panic the soldiers in the camps (verse 15) grab and strike at one another.

decisions.choice: each ... his fellow (L); one another, the other (B); one another, each other (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "each ... his fellow", used here of the soldiers of the enemy armies (m2), so it takes no gender setting. Balanced and Readable say "one another". Readable says "throw them into great panic" for "a great panic from the LORD will be among them".

source.text: וְגַ֨ם־יְהוּדָ֔ה תִּלָּחֵ֖ם בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאֻסַּף֩ חֵ֨יל כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֜ם סָבִ֗יב זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֛סֶף וּבְגָדִ֖ים לָרֹ֥ב מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And also Judah will fight at Jerusalem; and will be gathered [the] wealth of all the nations around, gold and silver and garments, in abundance very great.

en.L: And Judah too will fight at Jerusalem; and there will be gathered the wealth of all the nations round about, gold and silver and garments, in very great abundance.
en.B: Judah too will fight at Jerusalem. Riches from all the nations round about will be collected: gold, silver and clothing in great quantity.
en.R: The people of Judah will also fight at Jerusalem. The riches of all the nations around them will be gathered up: huge amounts of gold, silver and clothing.

es.L: Y también Judá peleará en Jerusalén; y será recogida la riqueza de todas las naciones de alrededor: oro y plata y vestidos en gran abundancia.
es.B: También Judá peleará en Jerusalén. Se recogerán las riquezas de todas las naciones de alrededor: oro, plata y ropa en gran cantidad.
es.R: La gente de Judá también peleará en Jerusalén. Se recogerán las riquezas de todas las naciones que la rodean: enormes cantidades de oro, plata y ropa.

fr.L: Et Juda aussi combattra à Jérusalem ; et on rassemblera la richesse de toutes les nations d’alentour, or, argent et vêtements en très grande abondance.
fr.B: Juda aussi combattra à Jérusalem. On rassemblera les richesses de toutes les nations d’alentour : de l’or, de l’argent et des vêtements en grande quantité.
fr.R: Les gens de Juda combattront eux aussi à Jérusalem. On ramassera les richesses de toutes les nations des environs : d’énormes quantités d’or, d’argent et de vêtements.

sw.L: Na Yuda pia atapigana huko Yerusalemu; na utajiri wa mataifa yote yanayozunguka utakusanywa, dhahabu na fedha na mavazi, kwa wingi mkubwa sana.
sw.B: Yuda naye atapigana huko Yerusalemu. Mali ya mataifa yote yanayozunguka itakusanywa: dhahabu, fedha na mavazi kwa wingi.
sw.R: Watu wa Yuda nao watapigana huko Yerusalemu. Mali ya mataifa yote yanayowazunguka itakusanywa: dhahabu nyingi mno, fedha na mavazi.

vi.L: Giu-đa cũng sẽ chiến đấu tại Giê-ru-sa-lem; và của cải của mọi nước chung quanh sẽ được gom lại, vàng, bạc và quần áo, rất nhiều vô kể.
vi.B: Giu-đa cũng sẽ chiến đấu tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Của cải của mọi nước chung quanh sẽ được thu gom: vàng, bạc và quần áo rất nhiều.
vi.R: Dân Giu-đa cũng sẽ chiến đấu tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Của cải của mọi nước chung quanh sẽ được thu gom lại: vô số vàng, bạc và quần áo.

ko.L: 유다도 예루살렘에서 싸울 것이다. 사방 모든 민족의 재물, 곧 금과 은과 옷이 아주 많이 모일 것이다.
ko.B: 유다도 예루살렘에서 싸울 것이다. 주위의 모든 민족에게서 금과 은과 옷 같은 재물을 아주 많이 거두어들일 것이다.
ko.R: 유다 사람들도 예루살렘에서 싸울 것이다. 주위의 모든 민족이 가진 엄청난 양의 금과 은과 옷을 거두어들일 것이다.

decisions.choice: fight at Jerusalem: in the city's defense, or against it
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "at" or "in", and also "against". Most read the verse as Judah fighting at Jerusalem, beside the city against the nations, as in 12:5-8. In 12:2 Judah too is caught up in the siege of Jerusalem, and some read this verse as Judah fighting against Jerusalem, forced by the enemy. The record says "at", which leaves the question open.

decisions.choice: the wealth of the nations gathered: the plunder of verse 1 reversed
decisions.reason: In verse 1 the enemy divided Jerusalem's plunder inside the city; now the wealth of the nations is gathered in. Haggai 2:7-8 and Isaiah 60:5, 11 also promise that the wealth of the nations will come to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: The people of Judah; huge amounts of (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "the people of Judah" for "Judah", and "huge amounts" for "in very great abundance".

source.text: וְכֵ֨ן תִּֽהְיֶ֜ה מַגֵּפַ֣ת הַסּ֗וּס הַפֶּ֨רֶד֙ הַגָּמָ֣ל וְהַחֲמ֔וֹר וְכָ֨ל־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה בַּמַּחֲנ֣וֹת הָהֵ֑מָּה כַּמַּגֵּפָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And so will be [the] plague of the horse, the mule, the camel, and the donkey, and all the livestock that will be in those camps, like this plague.

en.L: And so will be the plague of the horse, the mule, the camel and the donkey, and all the livestock that will be in those camps, like this plague.
en.B: A plague like this one will also strike the horses, mules, camels and donkeys, and all the animals that are in those camps.
en.R: The same kind of plague will also strike the horses, mules, camels and donkeys, and all the other animals in the enemy camps.

es.L: Y así será la plaga del caballo, del mulo, del camello y del asno, y de todo el ganado que esté en aquellos campamentos, como esta plaga.
es.B: Una plaga como esta herirá también a los caballos, mulos, camellos y asnos, y a todos los animales que haya en aquellos campamentos.
es.R: La misma clase de plaga caerá también sobre los caballos, los mulos, los camellos y los burros, y sobre todos los demás animales de los campamentos enemigos.

fr.L: Et ainsi sera la plaie du cheval, du mulet, du chameau et de l’âne, et de tout le bétail qui sera dans ces camps, comme cette plaie.
fr.B: Une plaie semblable frappera aussi les chevaux, les mulets, les chameaux et les ânes, et toutes les bêtes qui seront dans ces camps.
fr.R: Le même fléau frappera aussi les chevaux, les mulets, les chameaux et les ânes, et tous les autres animaux des camps ennemis.

sw.L: Na hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa tauni ya farasi, nyumbu, ngamia na punda, na wanyama wote watakaokuwa katika kambi hizo, kama tauni hii.
sw.B: Tauni kama hii itawapiga pia farasi, nyumbu, ngamia na punda, na wanyama wote walio katika kambi hizo.
sw.R: Tauni ya namna hiyo hiyo itawapiga pia farasi, nyumbu, ngamia na punda, na wanyama wengine wote katika kambi za adui.

vi.L: Tai vạ cũng sẽ như vậy trên ngựa, la, lạc đà và lừa, cùng mọi súc vật ở trong các trại quân ấy, giống như tai vạ này.
vi.B: Một tai vạ như thế cũng sẽ giáng trên ngựa, la, lạc đà, lừa và mọi súc vật trong các trại quân ấy.
vi.R: Tai vạ giống như vậy cũng sẽ giáng trên ngựa, la, lạc đà, lừa và mọi súc vật khác trong các trại quân thù.

ko.L: 그 진영들에 있을 말과 노새와 낙타와 나귀와 모든 가축에게 내릴 재앙도 이 재앙과 같을 것이다.
ko.B: 이와 같은 재앙이 그 진영들에 있는 말과 노새와 낙타와 나귀와 모든 짐승에게도 내릴 것이다.
ko.R: 같은 재앙이 원수의 진영에 있는 말과 노새와 낙타와 나귀와 다른 모든 짐승에게도 내릴 것이다.

decisions.choice: the horse, the mule, the camel and the donkey: the animals of an army's camp
decisions.reason: Armies used horses for chariots and riders, and mules, camels and donkeys to carry their supplies. The plague that strikes the enemy soldiers (verse 12) strikes their animals too, so that the whole army is struck. One of the plagues on Egypt struck "the horses, the donkeys, the camels" (Exodus 9:3).

decisions.choice: A plague like this one will also strike (B); The same kind of plague (R); the enemy camps (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring "like this plague" from the end of the verse to the start, and Readable says whose camps they are.

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כָּל־הַנּוֹתָר֙ מִכָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַבָּאִ֖ים עַל־יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְעָל֞וּ מִדֵּ֧י שָׁנָ֣ה בְשָׁנָ֗ה לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺת֙ לְמֶ֨לֶךְ֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְלָחֹ֖ג אֶת־חַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be [that] every one who remains of all the nations that came against Jerusalem, they will go up as often as year by year to bow down to [the] King, Yahweh of hosts, and to celebrate the festival of booths.

en.L: And it will be [that] every survivor of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up year by year to bow down to the King, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, and to keep the festival of booths.
en.B: Then all who survive from all the nations that attacked Jerusalem will go up every year to worship the King, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, and to keep the Festival of Booths.
en.R: All the people who are left alive from the nations that attacked Jerusalem will go up there every year. They will come to worship the King, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, and to celebrate the Festival of Booths.

es.L: Y sucederá [que] todo sobreviviente de todas las naciones que vinieron contra Jerusalén subirá año tras año a postrarse ante el Rey, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, y a celebrar la fiesta de las Cabañas.
es.B: Entonces todos los que sobrevivan de todas las naciones que atacaron Jerusalén subirán cada año a adorar al Rey, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, y a celebrar la fiesta de las Cabañas.
