es.R: Toda la gente que quede con vida de las naciones que atacaron Jerusalén subirá allá cada año. Vendrán a adorar al Rey, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, y a celebrar la fiesta de las Cabañas.

fr.L: Et il arrivera [que] tous les survivants de toutes les nations venues contre Jérusalem monteront année après année pour se prosterner devant le Roi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et pour célébrer la fête des Cabanes.
fr.B: Alors tous ceux qui resteront de toutes les nations qui ont attaqué Jérusalem monteront chaque année pour adorer le Roi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et pour célébrer la fête des Cabanes.
fr.R: Tous ceux qui seront encore en vie parmi les nations qui ont attaqué Jérusalem y monteront chaque année. Ils viendront adorer le Roi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et célébrer la fête des Cabanes.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, kila atakayesalia katika mataifa yote yaliyokuja juu ya Yerusalemu atapanda mwaka kwa mwaka kusujudu mbele ya Mfalme, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, na kuiadhimisha Sikukuu ya Vibanda.
sw.B: Kisha wote watakaosalia katika mataifa yote yaliyoushambulia Yerusalemu watapanda kila mwaka kumwabudu Mfalme, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, na kuiadhimisha Sikukuu ya Vibanda.
sw.R: Watu wote watakaobaki hai katika mataifa yaliyoushambulia Yerusalemu watapanda huko kila mwaka. Watakuja kumwabudu Mfalme, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, na kuiadhimisha Sikukuu ya Vibanda.

vi.L: Sẽ xảy ra, mọi người còn sót lại trong tất cả các nước đã đến tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ lên năm này qua năm khác để thờ lạy Vua, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, và để giữ Lễ Lều Tạm.
vi.B: Bấy giờ mọi người sống sót trong các nước đã tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ lên đó hằng năm để thờ phượng Vua, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, và để giữ Lễ Lều Tạm.
vi.R: Tất cả những người còn sống trong các nước đã tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ lên đó mỗi năm. Họ sẽ đến thờ phượng Vua, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, và dự Lễ Lều Tạm.

ko.L: 예루살렘을 치러 왔던 모든 민족 가운데서 남은 자는 모두 해마다 올라와서, 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이신 왕께 엎드려 절하고 초막절을 지킬 것이다.
ko.B: 예루살렘을 공격했던 모든 민족 가운데 살아남은 사람들은 다 해마다 올라와서, 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이신 왕께 경배하고 초막절을 지킬 것이다.
ko.R: 예루살렘을 공격했던 민족들 가운데 살아남은 사람들은 모두 해마다 그곳으로 올라갈 것이다. 그들은 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이신 왕께 경배하고 초막절을 지킬 것이다.

decisions.choice: the survivors of the nations will go up to worship: the nations join in Israel's worship
decisions.reason: Those who came to fight against Jerusalem come back as worshipers. The prophets look for the nations to come to Zion to learn the LORD's ways and to worship him (Isaiah 2:2-3; 66:23; Micah 4:1-2; Zechariah 8:20-23). "Go up" is the word for the pilgrimage to Jerusalem, which stands high in the hills (Psalm 122:4).

decisions.choice: the festival of booths: the autumn festival at the end of the harvest
decisions.reason: The Festival of Booths was kept for seven days from the fifteenth day of the seventh month, in the autumn, when the harvest was gathered in (Leviticus 23:34-43; Deuteronomy 16:13-15). It was one of the three festivals at which every man in Israel was to appear before the LORD (Deuteronomy 16:16). Israel lived in huts of branches to remember the journey through the wilderness after the LORD brought them out of Egypt (Leviticus 23:42-43). Now the nations are called to keep it.

decisions.choice: the King, the LORD of hosts
decisions.reason: Isaiah saw "the King, the LORD of hosts" in the temple (Isaiah 6:5), and verse 9 has said that the LORD will be king over all the earth. The pilgrims come to bow before him as subjects before their king.

decisions.choice: bow down (L); worship (B, R); the festival of booths (L); the Festival of Booths (B, R); the King (every level)
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus 23:34, Literal writes "the festival of booths" and Balanced and Readable "the Festival of Booths". The verb means to bow down, the act of worship; Balanced and Readable say "worship". "The King, the LORD of hosts" follows the published wording of Isaiah 6:5, and "the LORD of hosts" the wording set in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: "el Rey, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos"; "la fiesta de las Cabañas"
decisions.reason: The wording of the published Isaiah 6:5 and of Leviticus 23:34 and Deuteronomy 16:16 (meaning decisions m2, m3).

decisions.choice: "le Roi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées"; "la fête des Cabanes"
decisions.reason: The wording of the published Isaiah 6:5 and Leviticus 23:34 (meaning decisions m2, m3).

decisions.choice: "Mfalme, BWANA wa majeshi"; "Sikukuu ya Vibanda"
decisions.reason: The wording of the published Isaiah 6:5 and Leviticus 23:34 (meaning decisions m2, m3).

decisions.choice: "Vua, CHÚA Vạn Quân"; "Lễ Lều Tạm"
decisions.reason: The wording of the published Isaiah 6:5 and Leviticus 23:34 (meaning decisions m2, m3).

decisions.choice: "만군의 주이신 왕"; "초막절"
decisions.reason: The wording of the published Isaiah 6:5 and Leviticus 23:34 (meaning decisions m2, m3); the prophet speaks about the King, so the title takes -시-.

source.text: וְ֠הָיָה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־יַעֲלֶ֜ה מֵאֵ֨ת מִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ אֶל־יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֔ת לְמֶ֖לֶךְ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְלֹ֥א עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יִהְיֶ֥ה הַגָּֽשֶׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be [that] whoever not will go up from the families of the earth to Jerusalem to bow down to [the] King, Yahweh of hosts, and not on them will be the rain.

en.L: And it will be [that] whichever of the families of the earth does not go up to Jerusalem to bow down to the King, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, on them there will be no rain.
en.B: If any of the families of the earth fail to go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, no rain will fall on them.
en.R: Any of the peoples of the world that do not travel up to Jerusalem to worship the King, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, will get no rain.

es.L: Y sucederá [que] cualquiera de las familias de la tierra que no suba a Jerusalén a postrarse ante el Rey, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, sobre ellos no habrá lluvia.
es.B: Si alguna de las familias de la tierra no sube a Jerusalén a adorar al Rey, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, no caerá lluvia sobre ella.
es.R: Los pueblos del mundo que no suban a Jerusalén a adorar al Rey, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, no recibirán lluvia.

fr.L: Et il arrivera [que] celles des familles de la terre qui ne monteront pas à Jérusalem pour se prosterner devant le Roi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, sur elles il n’y aura pas de pluie.
fr.B: Si l’une des familles de la terre ne monte pas à Jérusalem pour adorer le Roi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, la pluie ne tombera pas sur elle.
fr.R: Les peuples du monde qui ne monteront pas à Jérusalem pour adorer le Roi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, n’auront pas de pluie.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, yeyote katika jamaa za dunia asiyepanda kwenda Yerusalemu kusujudu mbele ya Mfalme, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, juu yao hakutakuwa na mvua.
sw.B: Jamaa yoyote ya dunia isiyopanda kwenda Yerusalemu kumwabudu Mfalme, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, mvua haitanyesha juu yake.
sw.R: Watu wowote wa dunia wasiopanda kwenda Yerusalemu kumwabudu Mfalme, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, hawatapata mvua.

vi.L: Sẽ xảy ra, gia tộc nào trên đất không lên Giê-ru-sa-lem để thờ lạy Vua, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, thì sẽ không có mưa trên họ.
vi.B: Gia tộc nào trên đất không lên Giê-ru-sa-lem để thờ phượng Vua, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, thì mưa sẽ không rơi trên họ.
vi.R: Dân tộc nào trên thế giới không lên Giê-ru-sa-lem để thờ phượng Vua, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, thì sẽ không có mưa.

ko.L: 땅의 족속들 가운데서 누구든지 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이신 왕께 엎드려 절하러 예루살렘으로 올라오지 않으면, 그들에게는 비가 내리지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 땅의 족속들 가운데 어느 족속이든지 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이신 왕께 경배하러 예루살렘으로 올라오지 않으면, 그들에게 비가 내리지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 세상의 민족들 가운데 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이신 왕께 경배하러 예루살렘으로 올라가지 않는 민족은 비를 얻지 못할 것이다.

decisions.choice: the families of the earth: the words of the promise to Abraham
decisions.reason: "All the families of the earth" will be blessed in Abraham and his offspring (Genesis 12:3; 28:14). Here the families of the earth are called to come to Jerusalem to worship.

decisions.choice: no rain: the gift the season needed
decisions.reason: The Festival of Booths came at the end of the dry summer, just before the autumn rains on which the next year's crops depended. The LORD gives or withholds the rain (Deuteronomy 11:13-17; 1 Kings 17:1; Amos 4:7). Those who refuse to honor him as King will not receive his gift.

decisions.choice: the peoples of the world (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "peoples" for "families", since the word means the clans and nations of the earth, not households.

source.text: וְאִם־מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת מִצְרַ֧יִם לֹֽא־תַעֲלֶ֛ה וְלֹ֥א בָאָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה הַמַּגֵּפָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִגֹּ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶת־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יַֽעֲל֔וּ לָחֹ֖ג אֶת־חַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And if [the] family of Egypt not will go up and not come, and not on them; will be the plague with which will strike Yahweh the nations that not will go up to celebrate the festival of booths.

en.L: And if the family of Egypt does not go up and does not come, then not on them [will the rain fall]; there will be the plague with which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} strikes the nations that do not go up to keep the festival of booths.
en.B: If the people of Egypt do not go up and come, they will have no rain either; the plague will come on them with which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} strikes the nations that do not go up to keep the Festival of Booths.
en.R: If the people of Egypt do not go up to Jerusalem, they too will get no rain. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will strike them with the plague {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sends on the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Booths.

es.L: Y si la familia de Egipto no sube ni viene, entonces no sobre ellos [caerá la lluvia]; habrá la plaga con que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hiere a las naciones que no suben a celebrar la fiesta de las Cabañas.
es.B: Si el pueblo de Egipto no sube ni viene, tampoco tendrá lluvia; vendrá sobre ellos la plaga con que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hiere a las naciones que no suben a celebrar la fiesta de las Cabañas.
es.R: Si la gente de Egipto no sube a Jerusalén, tampoco recibirá lluvia. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} la herirá con la plaga que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} envía sobre las naciones que no suben a celebrar la fiesta de las Cabañas.

fr.L: Et si la famille d’Égypte ne monte pas et ne vient pas, alors pas sur eux [ne tombera la pluie] ; il y aura la plaie dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappe les nations qui ne montent pas pour célébrer la fête des Cabanes.
fr.B: Si le peuple d’Égypte ne monte pas et ne vient pas, il n’aura pas de pluie non plus ; viendra sur lui la plaie dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappe les nations qui ne montent pas célébrer la fête des Cabanes.
fr.R: Si les gens d’Égypte ne montent pas à Jérusalem, ils n’auront pas de pluie eux non plus. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les frappera du fléau qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} envoie sur les nations qui ne montent pas célébrer la fête des Cabanes.

sw.L: Na kama jamaa ya Misri haitapanda wala kuja, basi hakutakuwa [na mvua] juu yao; itakuwa tauni ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huyapiga nayo mataifa yasiyopanda kuiadhimisha Sikukuu ya Vibanda.
sw.B: Kama watu wa Misri hawatapanda wala kuja, nao pia hawatapata mvua; itawajia tauni ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huyapiga nayo mataifa yasiyopanda kuiadhimisha Sikukuu ya Vibanda.
sw.R: Kama watu wa Misri hawatapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, nao pia hawatapata mvua. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawapiga kwa tauni ambayo huyaletea mataifa yasiyopanda kuiadhimisha Sikukuu ya Vibanda.

vi.L: Nếu gia tộc Ai Cập không lên và không đến, thì trên họ cũng không [có mưa]; sẽ có tai vạ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dùng đánh các nước không lên giữ Lễ Lều Tạm.
vi.B: Nếu dân Ai Cập không lên và không đến, thì họ cũng sẽ không có mưa; tai vạ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dùng để đánh các nước không lên giữ Lễ Lều Tạm sẽ giáng trên họ.
vi.R: Nếu dân Ai Cập không lên Giê-ru-sa-lem, họ cũng sẽ không có mưa. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đánh họ bằng tai vạ mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giáng trên các nước không lên dự Lễ Lều Tạm.

ko.L: 이집트 족속이 올라오지 않고 오지 않으면, 그들에게도 [비가 내리지] 않을 것이다. 초막절을 지키러 올라오지 않는 민족들을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 치시는 그 재앙이 있을 것이다.
ko.B: 이집트 족속이 올라오지 않으면 그들에게도 비가 내리지 않을 것이며, 초막절을 지키러 올라오지 않는 민족들을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 치시는 그 재앙이 그들에게 내릴 것이다.
ko.R: 이집트 사람들이 예루살렘으로 올라가지 않으면, 그들도 비를 얻지 못할 것이다. 초막절을 지키러 올라가지 않는 민족들에게 내리시는 재앙으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 치실 것이다.

decisions.choice: and not on them: a hard text
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "and not on them", with no verb, so "the rain" of verse 17 must be understood: they too will have no rain. Egypt did not depend on rain but on the yearly flooding of the Nile (Deuteronomy 11:10-11), and this may be why the plague is named as Egypt's punishment. The Septuagint and the Syriac do not have "not", and read "then on them will come the plague". The record follows the Hebrew, supplying "rain" from verse 17.

decisions.choice: the family of Egypt: Egypt as one of the families of the earth
decisions.reason: Egypt, Israel's oppressor of old, is named as one of the "families of the earth" of verse 17, and so as one of the peoples called to worship in Jerusalem (compare Isaiah 19:19-25).

decisions.choice: [will the rain fall] (L); they will have no rain either (B); they too will get no rain (R)
decisions.reason: Every level supplies the rain from verse 17 (m1), and Literal brackets it. Readable leaves out "and come", which repeats "go up", and says "to Jerusalem".

source.text: זֹ֥את תִּהְיֶ֖ה חַטַּ֣את מִצְרָ֑יִם וְחַטַּאת֙ כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יַֽעֲל֔וּ לָחֹ֖ג אֶת־חַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: This will be [the] sin of Egypt and [the] sin of all the nations that not will go up to celebrate the festival of booths.

en.L: This will be Egypt's punishment, and the punishment of all the nations that do not go up to keep the festival of booths.
en.B: This will be the punishment for Egypt, and the punishment for all the nations that do not go up to keep the Festival of Booths.
en.R: This is how {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will punish Egypt and all the other nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Booths.

es.L: Este será el castigo de Egipto, y el castigo de todas las naciones que no suban a celebrar la fiesta de las Cabañas.
es.B: Este será el castigo para Egipto, y el castigo para todas las naciones que no suban a celebrar la fiesta de las Cabañas.
es.R: Así es como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} castigará a Egipto y a todas las demás naciones que no suban a celebrar la fiesta de las Cabañas.

fr.L: Tel sera le châtiment de l’Égypte, et le châtiment de toutes les nations qui ne monteront pas pour célébrer la fête des Cabanes.
fr.B: Ce sera là le châtiment de l’Égypte et le châtiment de toutes les nations qui ne monteront pas célébrer la fête des Cabanes.
fr.R: Voilà comment {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} punira l’Égypte et toutes les autres nations qui ne monteront pas célébrer la fête des Cabanes.

sw.L: Hii itakuwa adhabu ya Misri, na adhabu ya mataifa yote yasiyopanda kuiadhimisha Sikukuu ya Vibanda.
sw.B: Hii itakuwa adhabu kwa Misri, na adhabu kwa mataifa yote yasiyopanda kuiadhimisha Sikukuu ya Vibanda.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakavyoiadhibu Misri na mataifa mengine yote yasiyopanda kuiadhimisha Sikukuu ya Vibanda.

vi.L: Đây sẽ là hình phạt của Ai Cập, và hình phạt của mọi nước không lên giữ Lễ Lều Tạm.
vi.B: Đó sẽ là hình phạt dành cho Ai Cập và cho mọi nước không lên giữ Lễ Lều Tạm.
vi.R: Đó là cách {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ phạt Ai Cập và mọi nước khác không lên dự Lễ Lều Tạm.

ko.L: 이것이 이집트가 받을 벌이요, 초막절을 지키러 올라오지 않는 모든 민족이 받을 벌이다.
ko.B: 이것이 이집트가 받을 벌이며, 초막절을 지키러 올라오지 않는 모든 민족이 받을 벌이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이렇게 이집트와, 초막절을 지키러 올라가지 않는 다른 모든 민족을 벌하실 것이다.

decisions.choice: punishment: the word for "sin", used for what sin brings
decisions.reason: The word is the ordinary word for sin. Like the word for "iniquity" (Genesis 4:13; Lamentations 4:6), it can also mean the penalty that sin brings, and that is its sense here: this is what Egypt and the nations will suffer for refusing to come.

decisions.choice: punishment (every level); This is how the LORD will punish (R)
decisions.reason: Literal also says "punishment", since "the sin of Egypt" would not say what the word means here (m1). Readable names the LORD, who sends the plague (verse 18).

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ עַל־מְצִלּ֣וֹת הַסּ֔וּס קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֤ה הַסִּירוֹת֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה כַּמִּזְרָקִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: On that day will be on [the] bells of the horse, "Holiness to Yahweh"; and will be the pots in [the] house of Yahweh like the bowls before the altar.

en.L: In that day there will be [written] on the bells of the horses, "Holiness to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}"; and the pots in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be like the bowls before the altar.
en.B: On that day the bells of the horses will bear the words "Holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}", and in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the cooking pots will be like the bowls in front of the altar.
en.R: At that time even the bells on the horses will have the words "Holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}" written on them. The cooking pots in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be as holy as the bowls used at the altar.

es.L: En aquel día habrá [escrito] sobre las campanillas de los caballos: «Santidad {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}»; y las ollas en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} serán como los tazones delante del altar.
es.B: Aquel día las campanillas de los caballos llevarán las palabras «Santo para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}», y en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} las ollas serán como los tazones que están delante del altar.
es.R: En ese tiempo hasta las campanillas de los caballos tendrán escritas las palabras «Santo para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}». Las ollas del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} serán tan santas como los tazones que se usan en el altar.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, il y aura [écrit] sur les clochettes des chevaux : « Sainteté {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} » ; et les marmites dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} seront comme les coupes devant l’autel.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, les clochettes des chevaux porteront les mots « Saint pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} », et dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, les marmites seront comme les coupes devant l’autel.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, même les clochettes des chevaux porteront les mots « Saint pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ». Les marmites du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} seront aussi saintes que les coupes qui servent à l’autel.

sw.L: Katika siku ile kutakuwa [kumeandikwa] juu ya njuga za farasi, "Utakatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}"; na sufuria katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} zitakuwa kama mabakuli mbele ya madhabahu.
sw.B: Siku hiyo njuga za farasi zitakuwa na maneno haya, "Mtakatifu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}", na katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sufuria za kupikia zitakuwa kama mabakuli yaliyo mbele ya madhabahu.
sw.R: Wakati huo hata njuga za farasi zitaandikwa maneno haya, "Mtakatifu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}." Sufuria za kupikia katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} zitakuwa takatifu kama mabakuli yanayotumika madhabahuni.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, trên các chuông của ngựa sẽ có [khắc chữ]: "Thánh khiết cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}"; và các nồi trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ như các bát trước bàn thờ.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, các chuông của ngựa sẽ mang dòng chữ "Thánh, thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}", và trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} các nồi nấu sẽ như các bát trước bàn thờ.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, ngay cả các chuông trên ngựa cũng sẽ khắc dòng chữ "Thánh, thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Các nồi nấu trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng sẽ thánh như các bát dùng nơi bàn thờ.

ko.L: 그날에 말들의 방울에 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩함"이라고 [새겨져] 있을 것이요, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 있는 솥들이 제단 앞의 대접들과 같을 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에는 말들의 방울에도 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩함"이라는 글이 새겨질 것이며, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 있는 솥들도 제단 앞의 대접들과 같을 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에는 말들의 방울에까지 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩함"이라는 글이 새겨질 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 있는 솥들도 제단에서 쓰는 대접들만큼 거룩할 것이다.

decisions.choice: Holy to the LORD: the words on the high priest's gold plate
decisions.reason: "Holy to the LORD" was engraved on the gold plate on the high priest's turban (Exodus 28:36; 39:30). It marked him as set apart to the LORD. On that day the same words will be on the bells of horses, once the animals of war (9:10). What was written for the high priest alone will be true of ordinary things.

decisions.choice: bells: small bells or metal discs on a horse's harness
decisions.reason: The word is found only here. It is related to the word for cymbals and to a verb meaning "to ring", and it means bells or metal plates hung on a horse's harness.

decisions.choice: the pots ... like the bowls before the altar
decisions.reason: The pots were for cooking the meat of the sacrifices that worshipers ate (1 Samuel 2:13-14). The bowls were the basins used at the altar to catch the blood of the sacrifices and splash it on the altar (Exodus 27:3; 38:3; Numbers 7:13). The plainest vessels in the temple will be as holy as the most sacred.

decisions.choice: "Holiness to the LORD" (L); "Holy to the LORD" (B, R); as holy as (R)
decisions.reason: The inscription follows Exodus 28:36 at each level: Literal keeps the noun "Holiness", and Balanced and Readable say "Holy". Literal brackets "written", Balanced says "bear the words", and Readable explains the comparison of pots and bowls (m3). Readable says "temple" for "the house of the LORD".

decisions.choice: "Santidad {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}" (L); "Santo para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words of the published Exodus 28:36 at each level, the high priest's inscription (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "Sainteté {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}" (L); "Saint pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words of the published Exodus 28:36 at each level (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "Utakatifu kwa BWANA" (L); "Mtakatifu wa BWANA" (B, R); "njuga" for the bells
decisions.reason: The words of the published Exodus 28:36 at each level (meaning decision m1); "njuga" are the small bells worn on harness or ankles (m2).

decisions.choice: "Thánh khiết cho CHÚA" (L); "Thánh, thuộc về CHÚA" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words of the published Exodus 28:36 at each level (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "주께 거룩함" at every level
decisions.reason: The words of the published Exodus 28:36 (meaning decision m1), set in double quotation marks as words quoted within the oracle.

source.text: וְ֠הָיָה כָּל־סִ֨יר בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם וּבִֽיהוּדָ֗ה קֹ֚דֶשׁ לַיהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּבָ֨אוּ֙ כָּל־הַזֹּ֣בְחִ֔ים וְלָקְח֥וּ מֵהֶ֖ם וּבִשְּׁל֣וּ בָהֶ֑ם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֨ה כְנַעֲנִ֥י ע֛וֹד בְּבֵית־יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah holy to Yahweh of hosts, and will come all those who sacrifice and will take from them and will boil in them; and not will be a trader again in [the] house of Yahweh of hosts on that day.

en.L: And every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts; and all those sacrificing will come and take from them and boil [meat] in them. And there will no longer be a trader in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts in that day.
en.B: In Jerusalem and Judah every pot will be holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, and all who offer sacrifices will come and use them to boil their meat. And on that day there will no longer be a trader in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: In Jerusalem and Judah every cooking pot will be holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. All the people who come to offer sacrifices will take some of these pots and cook the meat in them. At that time there will no longer be any traders in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

es.L: Y toda olla en Jerusalén y en Judá será santa para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos; y vendrán todos los que sacrifican y tomarán de ellas y cocerán [carne] en ellas. Y no habrá más comerciante en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los ejércitos en aquel día.
es.B: En Jerusalén y en Judá toda olla será santa para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, y todos los que ofrezcan sacrificios vendrán y las usarán para cocer su carne. Y aquel día ya no habrá comerciante en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: En Jerusalén y en Judá toda olla de cocina será santa para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Todos los que vengan a ofrecer sacrificios tomarán algunas de esas ollas y cocerán en ellas la carne. En ese tiempo ya no habrá comerciantes en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

fr.L: Et toute marmite à Jérusalem et en Juda sera sainte pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées ; et tous ceux qui sacrifient viendront, en prendront et y feront cuire [la viande]. Et il n’y aura plus de marchand dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées en ce jour-là.
fr.B: À Jérusalem et en Juda, toute marmite sera sainte pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et tous ceux qui offrent des sacrifices viendront s’en servir pour faire cuire leur viande. Et ce jour-là, il n’y aura plus de marchand dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: À Jérusalem et en Juda, toutes les marmites seront saintes pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Tous ceux qui viendront offrir des sacrifices prendront certaines de ces marmites pour y faire cuire la viande. En ce temps-là, il n’y aura plus de marchands dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées.

sw.L: Na kila sufuria katika Yerusalemu na katika Yuda itakuwa takatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi; na wote wanaotoa dhabihu watakuja na kuchukua baadhi yake na kupika [nyama] ndani yake. Wala hapatakuwa tena mfanyabiashara katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi katika siku ile.
sw.B: Katika Yerusalemu na Yuda kila sufuria itakuwa takatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, na wote wanaotoa dhabihu watakuja na kuzitumia kupikia nyama yao. Na siku hiyo hapatakuwa tena mfanyabiashara katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.R: Katika Yerusalemu na Yuda kila sufuria ya kupikia itakuwa takatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Watu wote watakaokuja kutoa dhabihu watachukua baadhi ya sufuria hizo na kupikia nyama ndani yake. Wakati huo hapatakuwa tena na wafanyabiashara katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

vi.L: Mọi cái nồi ở Giê-ru-sa-lem và ở Giu-đa sẽ là thánh cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân; tất cả những người dâng sinh tế sẽ đến, lấy nồi ấy mà nấu [thịt] trong đó. Trong ngày ấy sẽ không còn con buôn trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân nữa.
vi.B: Tại Giê-ru-sa-lem và Giu-đa, mọi cái nồi sẽ là thánh cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, và tất cả những người dâng sinh tế sẽ đến dùng các nồi ấy mà nấu thịt. Vào ngày ấy, sẽ không còn con buôn trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân nữa.
vi.R: Tại Giê-ru-sa-lem và Giu-đa, mọi cái nồi nấu ăn sẽ là thánh cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân. Tất cả những người đến dâng sinh tế sẽ lấy một số nồi ấy mà nấu thịt. Vào lúc ấy, sẽ không còn con buôn nào trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân nữa.

ko.L: 예루살렘과 유다의 모든 솥이 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩할 것이다. 제사를 드리는 모든 사람이 와서 그 솥들을 가져다가 그 안에 [고기를] 삶을 것이다. 그날에는 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 다시는 장사꾼이 없을 것이다.
ko.B: 예루살렘과 유다의 모든 솥이 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩한 것이 될 것이며, 제물을 바치는 사람마다 와서 그 솥을 가져다가 고기를 삶을 것이다. 그날에는 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 장사꾼이 다시는 없을 것이다.
ko.R: 예루살렘과 유다에 있는 모든 솥이 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩한 것이 될 것이다. 제물을 바치러 오는 사람들은 모두 그 솥 가운데 얼마를 가져다가 거기에 고기를 삶을 것이다. 그때에는 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 다시는 장사꾼이 없을 것이다.

decisions.choice: every pot in Jerusalem and Judah holy: the whole land made holy
decisions.reason: Not only the temple vessels but every household pot will be holy and fit for worship, so that all the worshipers who come can cook their sacrifices. The line between holy and common is not removed but pushed out to cover everything. Exodus 19:6 called Israel "a kingdom of priests and a holy nation".

decisions.choice: all who sacrifice will take and boil in them
decisions.reason: Worshipers cooked and ate the meat of their peace offerings at the sanctuary (Deuteronomy 12:17-18; 1 Samuel 2:13-14). So many will come that every pot in the land will be needed, and all of them are holy enough for that use.

decisions.choice: trader: or "Canaanite"
decisions.reason: The word is "Canaanite". The Canaanites, above all the Phoenicians of the coast, were known as traders, and the word came to mean "merchant" (Proverbs 31:24; Zephaniah 1:11; Job 40:30). Here it most likely means traders buying and selling in the temple. It may instead mean a Canaanite, one who is unclean and outside the covenant (compare Ezekiel 44:9). Either way, nothing unholy will be in the LORD's house.

decisions.choice: no more traders in the house of the LORD: compare John 2:16
decisions.reason: When Jesus drove the traders out of the temple courts, he said, "Do not make my Father's house a house of trade" (John 2:16). The words are not quoted from this verse, but they agree with it. The book ends here, with the LORD's house and all Jerusalem and Judah holy to him.

decisions.choice: [meat] (L); their meat (B); the meat (R); trader (every level)
decisions.reason: Every level says "trader", the most likely sense, and the footnote gives "Canaanite" (m3). The Hebrew says only "boil in them"; Literal brackets "meat", and Balanced and Readable say what is boiled.
